| | **From The Chairman**
---
| | Chinese military aircraft [harassed](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=8fcda7f2d8f2435e810d3ba9b66d5f60&_e=_JA3tQvJfZaxlj3WNkoLsz4NQxUZy5xtZQkM9GZKPrDDa7x-mlKhrJ_uaSoRET7SumGVX9xRqXlqVUjtR9sEdviOiTaPc0ov6EZKCaddGo7zkRItu7wJl3JrieSF-zrMPEwtdaJ_2xdIZmXQQ3jKJ-hwpsjBEYs_2wbIqgUkDQOcVKxnGtbQ-QvRC_CvySBphQ5VgGe4ctAzKk55aHbr1lUCnaHaTRWW1iBAQ0zp9OLJc6KVEg8IMkZAuyXh-QvbQykJeMpq10FVonlGJEMpkcTQn-nee4D4hWFarCZ6WzM%3D) a Dutch naval vessel in the East China Sea last week. What was that Dutch ship doing, you might wonder? It was enforcing sanctions against the hostile and unstable regime in North Korea. Two Chinese aircraft circled the frigate HNLMS Tromp and buzzed a Dutch helicopter creating “a potentially unsafe situation” according to the Dutch Defense Ministry. This is just the latest incident of the People’s Liberation Army-Navy (PLAN) conducting aggressive and potentially dangerous fly-bys and approaches of vessels in international waters, conducting freedom of navigation patrols and internationally approved missions. These reckless maneuvers put allied lives at risk and create unstable situations. What would happen if a collision should occur? Well, we don’t need to wonder. In 2001 a Chinese aircraft [crashed](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=8fcda7f2d8f2435e810d3ba9b66d5f60&_e=_JA3tQvJfZaxlj3WNkoLs7eiqqNL3njNOaegCkeXUbAB0F8lcLi9XLo3MSQbUhIDN0j5WWLqqpwHxm6fxrjtOvyIn8kGwUI0Uz7eeXXzVPZhmC30QcQnJf7lHKTkZrrkBuO-XNn7DSrcjhuiGWhhOuDH1CFZjMHgCUeqJwMKbTw8vpN8yKAofDAX6yt_ceetEEIPDjasySlNbEfjvbtknB-fe-baiyqgXDGADm37a3pcvHyZ3nISsBu2DAUkA7j5MEaX-WcMuTJvm9gSrgxRp1MA2lxpRbVk3OfEGczyPPU%3D) into a U.S. Navy EP-3 killing the Chinese pilot and forcing the American aircraft to land on Hainan Island. Beijing got an intelligence coup, dismantling the aircraft, and Washington had to [apologize](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=8fcda7f2d8f2435e810d3ba9b66d5f60&_e=_JA3tQvJfZaxlj3WNkoLs4YJGKaG0LiqrEHoNaMYIRPDkidWojT1H8pFuhC9EyiFF81f0sRqlN3ZEEWQ1CT0amvropFsQxkMQgd9U0PGVZxLaXPe1obnBL4N45rPgT2D6CK3LvULvXZXAVV7Cv1y-LgaschB8772HwpQkyNxchAylEDWBELExIVTU3LJWskgSV-FcSVOQR5QrbMYvbT7DC4I57sWQoOkg41jx3jG1xt41AhVnwp4GOhRtkZv1o-E) for the pilot’s death (due to his own recklessness). We must stand firm against Beijing’s belligerence and show that this type of behavior is unacceptable.

| | Hi Peter,

Democrats in this state have been weakening our election laws, and they won’t stop. We must fight back, so we are taking the fight for election integrity straight to the voters.

Countless volunteers and grassroots organizations have been hard at work for MONTHS collecting signatures to get Voter ID on the ballot. name: Andrew Yang
subject: The Future of RCV
body:
| |
---
| | |
---
| [ ](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=efcb4e2457&e=0f227c2ae3)
---
|
A few years ago I was on a Zoom that would change my life. I was meeting with several advocates for Ranked Choice Voting. I asked them, “Who is the most prominent advocate for RCV?”

They said two words that stunned me: “Probably you.”

I wasn’t even an elected official. But it dawned on me that it’s very difficult for someone who’s inside the system to champion a change that enables more competition and dynamism. It’s not exactly the kind of thing most incumbents get excited about.

I’ve been a fan of Ranked Choice Voting ever since I found out about it – but it has now become perhaps the most important change I think we can make, particularly when combined with non-partisan primaries. It would make it so that our leaders actually have to listen to us and do right by us.

Shortly after that Zoom I was asked to join the Board of Fairvote Action by its founder and CEO, Rob Richie. Fairvote is a non-profit that enables and champions Ranked Choice Voting around the country. It has helped 27 straight cities – including places like New York and Seattle – adopt Ranked Choice Voting over these past years.

---
| [ ](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=df19dae452&e=0f227c2ae3)
---
|
“People are catching on that these electoral reforms are crucial to achieving the future we want,” says Meredith Sumpter, the new CEO of Fairvote whom I interview on the [podcast](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=2c8c9d91c3&e=0f227c2ae3) this week. Meredith grew up in Alaska stocking grocery shelves. “I grew up in an environment where you just got things done and didn’t talk about who believed what. I later went into business and worked as a diplomat, jumping back and forth between business and public service. I’ve been running an inclusive capitalism organization for the past several years. Everything kept leading me to systems change, which has now led me to Fairvote. Companies need government to be more effective in order to lead to a more inclusive economy, and Ranked Choice Voting is the reform that will make government more accountable and responsive.”

Meredith arrived at Fairvote while trying to make the economy more inclusive, but others I know arrived here because they cared about climate change or, in my case, poverty. “It’s been awesome meeting movement partners these past two months,” says Meredith. The Fairvote gala in New York last week served as both a celebration of Rob Richie and Cynthia Terrell for their 32 years of work with Fairvote as well as a passing of the torch to Meredith.

“I feel like I’m arriving at the right time as the movement is just growing in momentum. There’s a chance we triple the number of states who are using ranked choice voting statewide from 2 to 6 this November. Nevada, Colorado, Idaho and Montana could all join Maine and Alaska.” She’s right that this is a huge time for those of us who think that changing the way we vote is our best path forward. Ranked Choice Voting is spreading faster than most realize. Let’s continue to speed it up.

For my interview with Meredith [click here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=1721672830&e=0f227c2ae3). Folks, a quick note here from me.
I like to take a couple minutes to myself when I can, and reflect about why we’re doing this work. Today I was thinking back to what it felt like in 2016 when Trump won.
That terrible, terrible feeling. We didn’t know exactly what would come next, but we knew it would be bad.
Trump’s Supreme Court — his appointed justices — struck down Roe v. Wade. His “leadership” in the pandemic led to more than a million deaths. And his conspiracies and election denial pushed our democracy to the brink on January 6th.

The work we do between now and November is going to make all the difference on election day, and we have to make the most of each day.
Today, I’m asking you to make a donation to my campaign. Consider it an act of hope — hope that we can continue the progress we’ve made over the last few years, and that we can stop folks like Trump and Lake from gaining any more power and influence.

As we wrap up another school year, it's time to face some hard truths about the state of education in Oregon.

Oregon's education system is failing our kids. Recent studies show that our students fell even further behind in math and reading in 2023. Our reputation is as one of the worst states in the nation for kids' education.

This is unacceptable! [https://secure.winred.com/friends-of-christine-drazan/060624_school_sadrazan/?utm_source=Housefile&utm_medium=SA-Email&utm_campaign=06.06.24_School_SADrazan&utm_content=Link]

Our children deserve an education that sets them up for success, not one that leaves them struggling to catch up. Every child in Oregon deserves the opportunity to thrive.

That’s why I'm launching our End-of-School Survey. I want to hear from YOU. [https://secure.winred.com/friends-of-christine-drazan/060624_school_sadrazan/?utm_source=Housefile&utm_medium=SA-Email&utm_campaign=06.06.24_School_SADrazan&utm_content=Link] What do you think needs to change in our schools? Please take a few minutes to complete our survey. [https://secure.winred.com/friends-of-christine-drazan/060624_school_sadrazan/?utm_source=Housefile&utm_medium=SA-Email&utm_campaign=06.06.24_School_SADrazan&utm_content=Link] Our kids can’t afford to wait. Let’s work together to ensure every child in Oregon has the bright future they deserve.

Thank you for your commitment to oregon’s future,

Christine Drazan

It was a throw-away remark, made in a small virtual town hall meeting. The expression was retracted by me in the same breath in which I had made it. Everyone on the call laughed and (we thought) and perceived it to be a joke. Later analysis of the Zoom data shows that there were people on the call whose profiles were cloaked. We did not even know they were there. Next time you are on Zoom, remember that the attendees may not be restricted to the roster of people in the Hollywood squares.
The Town Hall was recorded, seemingly by someone holding up a phone to their computer during the call. The offhand remark was isolated and replayed out of context.
Thanks for reading Paula's Substack! Subscribe for free to receive new posts and support my work.
[Pledge your support](https://substack..92XlyphUHHjzN9gznS5YRQrJWaxBl9KZphpAPBlk9Tg?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=145524476)
I was contacted at about 3pm the next day for a comment about it from Fox News. "My deadline is 4pm," said the email. I quickly tapped out a response and hit "send". I had a virtual court appearance for a client at that same hour and really was not able to focus on my response. The Fox News spot aired nationwide at 5pm. By 5:30pm, my campaign Facebook page was invaded by "bots" or internet "trolls." The platform formerly known as Twitter suddenly spiked and began to fill with other bots. We knew they were not real people because the profiles had no school, bio, or pictures, and they had been created recently.
By 10pm live humans from across the country followed bots.
Let that sink in: the humans followed the bots. Would they follow the bots anywhere, and say anything, simply because they read it online? Are people really led, or mis-led, that easily?
The written messages varied from school-yard "you stupid" to the most awful, graphic, sinister name-calling you can imagine. Let me tell you - in my law practice, I deal with some pretty shady characters who speak a flowery sub-dialect of English not appropriate for mixed company. I thought I had heard it all. Nah. The MAGA supporters who hurled gender-based epithets at me took it to an entirely different level, mis-spellings and all.
Physical threats began pouring in just as I was settling in to go to sleep.
The phone began to ring on what was apparently autodial. Over and over and over. I turned it off. A few minutes later I turned it on. Same thing. I turned off the phone. I went through this three times. But wait - if something happened, I needed a working phone. I turned it back on and silenced it.
The next day I contacted the local sheriff. I wanted them to know my name and address in case I called, as well as some context for what could possibly happen.
The NY Post did an article on it. That was about the most fair-minded account of all that I have seen thus far. I'm humbled and thrilled that they likened my situation to that of Hillary Clinton's. That was an unexpected honor.
Other media outlets of varying obscurity contacted me. Some of them seemed legit. The vast majority were not.
Initially I was triggered. My daughter and I experienced domestic violence when I was getting divorced, and then during two other periods scattered over several years during a fraught custody and visitation arrangement. We know what it is like to go into hiding. It is an unfortunate muscle memory that is, apparently, still with us. We both began making plans to ensure our safety. These are odd skill sets that I wish we didn't have, but I was grateful for them last week.
The bottom line is: we are safe. That is the most important thing.
Further analyses of the calls, messages, and social media posts reveal that the overwhelming majority of actual human responses came from out of state. Only a handful came from within New York. There is only one point of contact that I think was

[Start a Substack](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/39cdade7-ab40-4c4e-aeb6-d8800bc4a650?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
from someone who lives in New York's 21st Congressional District.
Again: we are safe. We won't let our respective guards down, but we won't let it paralyze us either.
As for the calls for civics education, I don't plan to back down. If anything, this incident of bots leading the MAGAs into a sinister attack across multiple means of communication proves that we need civics education. And I'm not the only one calling for it. Coincidentally, George Conway called for "reprogramming" the very next day on the Daily Show.
Now, I have to tell you, as a consumer of political news, I have plenty of reactions to things I read or hear on television and social media. I assure you: I have never called or tweeted to a candidate out of state in a message filled with expletives and debased references to their anatomy. Never. And I don't even think that's a "yet" for me. Similarly, I believe that most average people would never think to engage in this type of childish retort to an out-of-state candidate's off-hand remark.
The bad news about this is that, for now, comments and other interactions on social media are turned off.
The good news is that Fox News played the clip nationwide. The whole country now knows about the campaign. Thanks, Fox News. You saved me hundreds of thousands of dollars in campaign marketing.
We learned something in the last few days. Clearly the other side is concerned about Collins for Congress in NY-21. Help me spread the word: we've got their attention, and we aren't backing down.
Thanks for reading Paula's Substack! Subscribe for free to receive new posts and support my work.

Coincidentally, George Conway called for "reprogramming" the very next day on the Daily Show. Now, I have to tell you, as a consumer of political news, I have plenty of reactions to things I read or hear on television and social media. I assure you: I have never called or tweeted to a candidate out of state in a message filled with expletives and debased references to their anatomy. Never. And I don't even think that's a "yet" for me. Similarly, I believe that most average people would never think to engage in this type of childish retort to an out-of-state candidate's off-hand remark. The bad news about this is that, for now, comments and other interactions on social media are turned off. The good news is that Fox News played the clip nationwide. The whole country now knows about the campaign. Thanks, Fox News. You saved me hundreds of thousands of dollars in campaign marketing. We learned something in the last few days. Clearly the other side is concerned about Collins for Congress in NY-21. Help me spread the word: we've got their attention, and we aren't backing down. Thanks for reading Paula's Substack! Subscribe for free to receive new posts and support my work. If we haven 't met yet, I am Paula Collins, the Democratic and Working Families Party Candidate for New York's 21st Congressional District. Your comments are invaluable to me. Please let me hear from you. Remember that you can always visit my website at www.paulacollinsforcongress.com or by sending me a text at 315-230-3920. | | | | | | | (C) 2024 Paula Collins 548 Market Street PMB 72296, San Francisco, CA 94104 ? ?

When I was a baby lawyer working in Washington, DC, I was grateful to build avenues for expression both within--and also beyond--my legal practice and work in the non-profit arena. My first grassroots organizing project in the nation's capital was the [DC Guerrilla Poetry Insurgency](https://substack.com/redirect/42aa54b3-173b-4f9e-a545-0444c3f82a06?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Performing antiwar poetry and music in public spaces was always a joy, and it embodied many of the reasons why direct action can be so compelling. In addition to building community, reclaiming public space, promoting dissent in the face of bipartisan militarism, and allowing observers (who we routinely invited to take the mic) to step into the role of creators, it also sparked any number of essentially random connections.
_Chronicles of a Dying Empire is a publication supported by readers, rather than advertisers. To receive new posts, sign up for a**free subscription!** To support my work, please consider becoming a paid subscriber._
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..GjrnprdDqFX241lzkjLF_I2RkKgW_sb-u-iruc8Zk_k?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=145525630)
One of my favorite was with David Cobb, who I knew as the Green Party's presidential candidate in 2004. David had worked as a lawyer and activist in Texas, and went on to serve on the Board of Directors for the Green Institute, and the Sierra Club's national Corporate Accountability Committee. He has also worked as a Fellow with the Liberty Tree Foundation for the Democratic Revolution, and as a Principal with the Program on Corporations, Law, and Democracy (POCLAD).
Back when I had first moved to Washington, David didn't know me from a hole in the wall. But sometime in maybe 2005 or 2006, we met in the streets of the capital when he happened to cross Dupont Circle (a public park inside a traffic circle flanked by subway stations and ringed by bars & restaurants) during one of the poetry insurgency's lyrical ambushes. We were happy to hand him the mic, and I recall feeling elated when he nimbly picked up right where we had left off.
David & I have stayed friends ever since, and his vision continues to inform and inspire my activism.

---|---|---
David shares his formidable insight into law, politics, and activism through an insightful podcast also available on Substack at [Redneck Gone Green](https://open.substack.com/pub/redneckgonegreen?utm_source=mentions). Tomorrow (Tuesday, June 11) at 3pm Pacific Time, we'll reconnect for a live discussion exploring some themes in my recent writing.

name: Jenkins, Colby
subject: I'm a combat veteran - our border is being invaded.
body:
...if you think our country is on the right track, then vote for Celeste Maloy. If you want someone who will fight for our conservative Utah values without compromising our principles, then vote for Colby Jenkins.
No images? [Click here](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-e-ehtkkul-trihsurjy-jj/) [](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehtkkul-trihsurjy-r/) [CLICK HERE TO WATCH THE FULL DEBATE](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehtkkul-trihsurjy-y/) Dear Friends,If you didn't get a chance to watch today's [2nd Congressional District debate](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehtkkul-trihsurjy-j/), please do so when you can. **You will observe a clear difference between Colby Jenkins and Celeste Maloy**.In her short time in office, Celeste Maloy has voted **with the majority of Democrats** , **against the majority of Republicans** , and **against the will of the majority of voters in our district** to [increase spending](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehtkkul-trihsurjy-t/), to continue [warrantless wiretaps of American citizens](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehtkkul-trihsurjy-i/), and to [ignore the invasion at our border](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehtkkul-trihsurjy-d/). Colby Jenkins is former Special Forces Green Beret combat veteran who has dedicated 30 years of his life to defending our country. **He is running [to cut reckless spending](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehtkkul-trihsurjy-n/), [reduce inflation](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehtkkul-trihsurjy-p/), and [secure our border](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehtkkul-trihsurjy-x/). **Republicans have a razor thin majority in Congress and, as such, there has likely never been a time that one vote is more impactful. The question is - will that one vote be a **principled conservative** **who isn't willing to surrender to the democrats**? Or, will that one vote be for more of the same - **more out of control spending** , **more generational debt, more inflation, and more catch and release?** Our congressional majority might be slim, but a supermajority of Americans want Republicans to own that slim majority and not **just show up, but stand up on principle. **The choice is clear - **if you think Congress is doing a good job and you think our country is on the right track, then vote for Celeste Maloy.** However, if you want someone who **will fight for our conservative Utah values without compromising our principles, then vote for Colby Jenkins.****It is time to elect leaders who are willing to push back and fight for the budget and values that we want, instead of compromising our principles and hitting singles and doubles for the wrong team, time and time again. ****[Vote Colby Jenkins for Congress!](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehtkkul-trihsurjy-m/)** [CLICK: LEARN ABOUT MY OPPONENTS SINGLES AND DOUBLES](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehtkkul-trihsurjy-q/) [](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehtkkul-trihsurjy-a/) [PLEASE CONSIDER DONATING TODAY](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehtkkul-trihsurjy-f/)
## [**RECENT ENDORSEMENTS:**](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehtkkul-trihsurjy-z/)
[](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehtkkul-trihsurjy-v/) [](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehtkkul-trihsurjy-e/) [](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehtkkul-trihsurjy-s/) [](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehtkkul-trihsurjy-g/) [](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehtkkul-trihsurjy-w/) [](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehtkkul-trihsurjy-yd/) [](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehtkkul-trihsurjy-yh/)[](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehtkkul-trihsurjy-yk/)[](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehtkkul-trihsurjy-yu/)[](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehtkkul-trihsurjy-jl/)[](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehtkkul-trihsurjy-jr/) [](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehtkkul-trihsurjy-jy/) [ Share ](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-fb-ehtkkul-trihsurjy-jt/) [ Tweet ](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-tw-ehtkkul-trihsurjy-ji/) [ Share ](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-li-ehtkkul-trihsurjy-jd/) [ Forward ](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.forwardtomyfriend.com/t-trihsurjy-F0A48A54-ehtkkul-l-jh) | Paid for by Colby Jenkins for Congress You are receiving this email because you have been identified as an Utah voter, or you have subscribed through our website. | | Good day, fellow American. You are an informed citizen—I believe that wholeheartedly. You love this country. [Yes](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ze4n43pmocve9f0ev6j63vmbtf6fknm5s02tspcg_rp22sh2s8i6ep30shg6cor5c9h2bs) [No](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zi1sr8t0m6l11itdi6pfnm2vtdj6ke2vqhm1t58o_rp22sh2s8i6ep30shg6cor5c9h2bs) [Not Sure / Don't Know](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zv84do6gums8e0c8a7b14ltg0m6pjm1t2cmets3o_rp22sh2s8i6ep30shg6cor5c9h2bs)
We need more citizens like you— _informed citizens_ —because America is at a turning point. Dangerous left-wing ideologies are taking hold thanks to a decades-long campaign by progressives to attack the Constitution and undermine liberty and patriotism. The country you and I love will be lost forever if we fail to restore knowledge about the Constitution among our fellow citizens. We can’t let that happen! That’s why I am writing to you today and asking you to be part of Hillsdale College and our nationwide initiative—the **CAMPAIGN FOR INFORMED CITIZENS**. We are the foremost educational institution committed to reaching and teaching millions about freedom and limited government. The goal of this campaign is to build generations of knowledgeable Americans who understand
* WHAT the Constitution says;
* HOW it relates to current issues and events; and
* WHY the preservation of constitutional principles is essential to liberty.

If this campaign is successful, we will spread knowledge about the Constitution among millions of citizens, especially young people, that our education system failed. These are young people that “educators” deliberately deceived or who just haven’t learned about a proper understanding of American history in school. **You are essential to the success of this effort to make America more knowledgeable.** That’s because we’re seeking _1,000 people_ in each state to help us teach the Constitution and its underlying principles of liberty to _10,000,000 Americans_ , and this initiative starts with you—YOUR knowledge and YOUR insights. And we must do this work without ONE PENNY of federal or state taxpayer support, even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. Instead, we put our trust in citizens like you who want what’s best for the country. So please, share your opinions by completing the **National Survey on the State of American Education** today at the link below. Thank you for reading my email! | | Good day, fellow American. You are an informed citizen—I believe that wholeheartedly. You love this country. You make an effort to understand what the U.S. Constitution says and what it means, and you aren’t afraid to stand up for America’s founding and the principles of liberty that define our nation. _**[Your leadership and knowledge are needed today...](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zkb287ctok24s5afpo3715p803319evo8l33ibmo_rp22sh2s8i6ep30shg6aob2c3h2bs)_**

## Do you believe it is important for Americans to have basic knowledge of American history and civics, including knowledge about the Constitution?
[Yes](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z1nhi5lc1lfrqn48ibmeo5knqit6cjo4jhspe4b0_rp22sh2s8i6ep30shg6aob2c3h2bs) [No](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z1u76fukken0rfpomt4nts3if2oqrr5eg5n4si80_rp22sh2s8i6ep30shg6aob2c3h2bs) [Not Sure / Don't Know](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z1pkblnpjlsa79a8bihh8eu2vm4rqmrcrbnre408_rp22sh2s8i6ep30shg6aob2c3h2bs)
We need more citizens like you— _informed citizens_ —because America is at a turning point. Dangerous left-wing ideologies are taking hold thanks to a decades-long campaign by progressives to attack the Constitution and undermine liberty and patriotism. The country you and I love will be lost forever if we fail to restore knowledge about the Constitution among our fellow citizens. We can’t let that happen! That’s why I am writing to you today and asking you to be part of Hillsdale College and our nationwide initiative—the **CAMPAIGN FOR INFORMED CITIZENS**. We are the foremost educational institution committed to reaching and teaching millions about freedom and limited government. The goal of this campaign is to build generations of knowledgeable Americans who understand
* WHAT the Constitution says;
* HOW it relates to current issues and events; and
* WHY the preservation of constitutional principles is essential to liberty.

If this campaign is successful, we will spread knowledge about the Constitution among millions of citizens, especially young people, that our education system failed. These are young people that “educators” deliberately deceived or who just haven’t learned about a proper understanding of American history in school. **You are essential to the success of this effort to make America more knowledgeable.** That’s because we’re seeking _1,000 people_ in each state to help us teach the Constitution and its underlying principles of liberty to _10,000,000 Americans_ , and this initiative starts with you—YOUR knowledge and YOUR insights. And we must do this work without ONE PENNY of federal or state taxpayer support, even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. Instead, we put our trust in citizens like you who want what’s best for the country. So please, share your opinions by completing the **National Survey on the State of American Education** today at the link below. Thank you for reading my email! [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/survey-informed-citizen/**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zc4g2edq55s94ovu77l7n7qmkmuvhqm6h703veog_rp22sh2s8i6ep30shg6aob2c3h2bs) For our children, Bill Gray, ‘01 Vice President Institutional Advancement Hillsdale College

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: game changer?
body:
Right now, abortion is on the ballot in multiple states for November’s election...
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

Right now, abortion is on the ballot in multiple states for November’s election.

It’s all part of a desperate attempt by the Abortion Lobby to get out the vote, believing abortion could save President Biden’s failing re-election campaign.

Pro-Life Friend, the American people don’t want abortion through all nine months of a pregnancy legalized in their states! _Overwhelming majorities – including key demographics like Hispanics and women – agree that’s sick!_

**So, the President and his pro-abortion cohorts are vulnerable – _we just have to help our volunteers and students fight back with the right tools._**
[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gzjlyd-duchtdja-y/)
That’s why _Students for Life Action_ is releasing _**Ballot Referendum Kits**_ to help push back against ballot initiatives and signature collection efforts undertaken by the Abortion Lobby across the country!

**[Will you please consider making your most generous contribution to _Students for Life Action_ to help us distribute these kits to volunteers in key referendum states](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gzjlyd-duchtdja-j/)?**

Pro-Life Friend, we’ve seen time and time again the Abortion Lobby and their corporate funders rely on signature collection campaigns and ballot referendums to try and shove late-term abortion down our throats.

They use these methods because they know media elites will do everything in their power to hide the true purpose of pro-abortion referendums.

And then they make matters worse by making the actual referendum language as confusing as possible . . .

Obfuscation and confusion (and hundreds of millions by pro-abortion billionaires like Geroge Soros) allow the pro-abortion side to push the issue further than voters understand or even want – _and for abortion, that means almost no restrictions at all._

Which is why these _**Ballot Referendum Kits**_ are so important.

After all, the only way we can stop the Abortion Lobby’s disinformation campaign is to fight it with the _**TRUTH!**_

With your help, we’re offering our student activists and volunteer canvassers (of any age) _**TWO**_ separate grassroots activism kits to help turn the tables on the Abortion Lobby:

\- The first for getting people in states with pending ballot referendum signature collection campaigns to **“Decline to Sign”** the petitions to put abortion on their ballot; and

\- The second for getting voters to commit to **“Vote No”** when late-term abortion measures are confirmed to be on their ballot.
Both our **“Vote No”** and **“Decline to Sign”** kits contain:

• 200 Door Hangers;
• 50 Topic Cards;
• 50 Church Bulletins;
• 25 Recruitment Topic Cards;
• 20 Flyers;
• 5 Recruitment Flyers;
• 1 Leadership Book;
• 1 _Standing with You_ Community Advocate Tee; and
• 1 Campaign Strategy Guidebook.
These materials will serve to train our volunteers as well as educate and inform voters about the reality of late-term abortion referendums – _not to mention converting many voters to the Pro-Life Movement!_

**[And right now, a generous gift of $650 will supply 10 of our student activists or door-to-door canvassers with Ballot Referendum Kits](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gzjlyd-duchtdja-i/)!**

Obviously, one of President Biden’s biggest failures is this economy, so I understand if that’s just too much for you right now.

**But with so much on the line in 2024, these kits are critical to our success in November, so it would be a BIG help if you could chip in at least:**

**>>** **[$325 to supply 5 activists/canvassers with kits](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gzjlyd-duchtdja-d/);**

**>>** **[$130 to supply 2 activists/canvassers with kits](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gzjlyd-duchtdja-h/); or**

**>>** **[$65 to supply 1 activist/canvasser with a kit](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gzjlyd-duchtdja-k/).** [](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gzjlyd-duchtdja-u/)
Pro-Life Friend, the mainstream press and the Democrats want the Pro-Life Movement discouraged, our morale low, and for us to believe that the Pro-Life Movement is a political loser in 2024.

**They know many of President Biden’s pro-abortion backers just may stay home in November – _so they want pro-lifers to as well!_**

That’s why we’re equipping our grassroots army with the resources, kits, and tools they need to beat the Abortion Lobby at their own game.

But it’s going to take the support of good folks like you to pull it off.

It’s going to take all of us to win in 2024.

**[So, Pro-Life Friend, will you please consider making your most generous contribution of $650, $325, $130, or $65 right away to help us supply our student activists and canvassers with Ballot Referendum Kits ASAP](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gzjlyd-duchtdja-o/)?**

**[Even a gift of $25 or just $10 would be much appreciated](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gzjlyd-duchtdja-b/)!**

Thank you for everything you do for Life!

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

P.S. – If you’d like us to send YOU one or more _**Ballot Referendum Kits,**_ you can order them by clicking the links below.

**>>_TO ORDER THE “VOTE NO” KIT, VISIT_ :**
**[https://shop.prolifegen.org/product/ballot-referendum-response-kit-vote-no/](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gzjlyd-duchtdja-n/)**

**>>_TO ORDER THE “DECLINE TO SIGN” KIT, VISIT_ :**
**[https://shop.prolifegen.org/product/ballot-referendum-response-kit-decline-to-sign/](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gzjlyd-duchtdja-p/)**

Greetings Peter,

There is a tidal wave of errors in our voter rolls that are drowning your vote. Across 11 states, there are millions of voter registration records from the 2022 mid-term with what appear to be facially disqualifying errors in the record.

For example, some voter records show a registration date after the voter actually voted. This occurs when a voter legitimately gets a court order to vote on election day due to some sort of error. To get a court order both the voter and the judicial system must exert significant effort and process. Observing 6 million of such errors suggests a severe breach in our protective mesh of state and federal election laws.

---
| | Dear Fellow American, Americans consistently rate Congress as one of the most unpopular branches of our government. But do you know how the “sausage is made” in the halls of the U.S. Congress? Here’s a preview: It’s a far cry from the _Schoolhouse Rock!_ song many of us learned as kids. We have to go back to how our Founding Fathers designed the U.S. Congress if we’re going to understand this fully. Thankfully, Hillsdale College created our free online course, **“Congress: How It Worked and Why It Doesn’t,”** to do just that.****
---
| | And right now—for a limited time—this online course is available in a special DVD box set for viewing in your home or with a small group. **You can order your copy at this secure link:** **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/congress-thank-you](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/VZZsXE4BCaMxnLGH5DF6Xw~~/AARclAA~~~)** The 11-lecture course explores the Founders’ understanding of the legislative power and how Congress **should** work, the progressive rejection of that understanding, and how it has affected American politics. You can get your DVD box set of **“Congress: How It Worked and Why It Doesn’t”** right away with a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more.
---
| [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/VZZsXE4BCaMxnLGH5DF6Xw~~/AARclAA~~~)
---
| | And by doing so, your gift will also support our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts that **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans nationwide. | | Good day, fellow American. You are an informed citizen--I believe that wholeheartedly. You love this country. You make an effort to understand what the U.S. Constitution says and what it means, and you aren't afraid to stand up for America's founding and the principles of liberty that define our nation. _**[Your leadership and knowledge are needed today ...](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=5b79de6261bb48b19530e8aa5628751d&_e=6G1JTtet0uGSETxjmX_7_ajiWUejU1itD_bZVGemW0q7a9gRofYzEcMP6_IbQ6mTEBiI8tOFRBhyVOMCDDLZT-B9c9bEelws63kauyUdHDrghE8T8eBPTinv02Puch2uJAtD4hpMe60FshYyIhxscDiElweFHWHG_n8QB6YSEfTrY12ATOPcHVL086b7GXWdpy1dzqZm6g6Id4gertmexPjx5hSysO3PMLECkoCDtDu-CfFI1h40JFv6ZBHQgAi2EUNzC-zfqYFRFZdFZGE3SU-eWf4IZgGTxrXzzwQ2C-nn1thusawX_5Kgg4ki7UynrsdAbzJYTkiC52S6eWIvDv7qoapJqtdBCJzF59kFPRMw5vnwYiegd4zUFV_S7EZCz2NKKKkIAIrvvIN_Knr4Mg%3D%3D)**_

## Do you believe it is important for Americans to have basic knowledge of American history and civics, including knowledge about the Constitution?
[Yes](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=5b79de6261bb48b19530e8aa5628751d&_e=6G1JTtet0uGSETxjmX_7_ajiWUejU1itD_bZVGemW0q7a9gRofYzEcMP6_IbQ6mTEBiI8tOFRBhyVOMCDDLZT-B9c9bEelws63kauyUdHDrghE8T8eBPTinv02Puch2uJAtD4hpMe60FshYyIhxscDiElweFHWHG_n8QB6YSEfTrY12ATOPcHVL086b7GXWdpy1dzqZm6g6Id4gertmexPjx5hSysO3PMLECkoCDtDu-CfFI1h40JFv6ZBHQgAi2Yz0NquX2yTe5iZlw8UGNkIzTPNwke03yOfH9XtnIyxbfIB9gZr7ko0yq4Ldu1FTr8K7riabNkpp9kSQKNbjIYOxP2-VqPCZXFC77n3G9NwiRs14LhUXk11a0EfaBfRL7Pni3QZuu8xW2yyGwIyA6Cw%3D%3D) [No](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=5b79de6261bb48b19530e8aa5628751d&_e=6G1JTtet0uGSETxjmX_7_ajiWUejU1itD_bZVGemW0q7a9gRofYzEcMP6_IbQ6mTEBiI8tOFRBhyVOMCDDLZT-B9c9bEelws63kauyUdHDrghE8T8eBPTinv02Puch2uJAtD4hpMe60FshYyIhxscDiElweFHWHG_n8QB6YSEfTrY12ATOPcHVL086b7GXWdpy1dzqZm6g6Id4gertmexPjx5hSysO3PMLECkoCDtDu-CfFI1h40JFv6ZBHQgAi2q8sGvoi1rYwjO2vi3lifLcVworytS7ZG5xrEEoxbdGZKs7d1oygqzbWJiJ6qNToUWNbJqnWwetEYPI084c1uugOX98scGzk_C8wDLWtbBiGxDz4dTfE7c7-MAbeNBg-5l0PB7IpU7eKA6KkiGimP3w%3D%3D) [Not Sure / Don't Know](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=5b79de6261bb48b19530e8aa5628751d&_e=6G1JTtet0uGSETxjmX_7_ajiWUejU1itD_bZVGemW0q7a9gRofYzEcMP6_IbQ6mTEBiI8tOFRBhyVOMCDDLZT-B9c9bEelws63kauyUdHDrghE8T8eBPTinv02Puch2uJAtD4hpMe60FshYyIhxscDiElweFHWHG_n8QB6YSEfTrY12ATOPcHVL086b7GXWdpy1dzqZm6g6Id4gertmexPjx5hSysO3PMLECkoCDtDu-CfFI1h40JFv6ZBHQgAi2i2qAm_Z7hdkQWIEaZXPQPejtTP0NVDClkEF7RlYHMJz9MDjQ3Y8N2Rp5ao9UYNj2FfFgDf4crGhVwX2lL9ueSMWc5gdBJ6gtAvdoDBOhWK_ZKKHzYx6SeoyrWXGIg00Sl6riX6rLSkuRjUKiTRV7Pg%3D%3D) We need more citizens like you--_informed citizens_ --because America is at a turning point. Dangerous left-wing ideologies are taking hold thanks to a decades-long campaign by progressives to attack the Constitution and undermine liberty and patriotism. The country you and I love will be lost forever if we fail to restore knowledge about the Constitution among our fellow citizens. We can't let that happen! That's why I am writing to you today and asking you to be part of Hillsdale College and our nationwide initiative--the **CAMPAIGN FOR INFORMED CITIZENS**. We are the foremost educational institution committed to reaching and teaching millions about freedom and limited government. The goal of this campaign is to build generations of knowledgeable Americans who understand
* WHAT the Constitution says;
* HOW it relates to current issues and events; and
* WHY the preservation of constitutional principles is essential to liberty.

If this campaign is successful, we will spread knowledge about the Constitution among millions of citizens, especially young people, that our education system failed. These are young people that "educators" deliberately deceived or who just haven't learned about a proper understanding of American history in school. **You are essential to the success of this effort to make America more knowledgeable. ** That's because we're seeking _1,000 people_ in each state to help us teach the Constitution and its underlying principles of liberty to _10,000,000 Americans_ , and this initiative starts with you--YOUR knowledge and YOUR insights. And we must do this work without ONE PENNY of federal or state taxpayer support, even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. Instead, we put our trust in citizens like you who want what's best for the country. So please, share your opinions by completing the **National Survey on the State of American Education **today at the link below. Thank you for reading my email! [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/survey-informed-citizen/**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=5b79de6261bb48b19530e8aa5628751d&_e=6G1JTtet0uGSETxjmX_7_ajiWUejU1itD_bZVGemW0q7a9gRofYzEcMP6_IbQ6mTEBiI8tOFRBhyVOMCDDLZT-B9c9bEelws63kauyUdHDrghE8T8eBPTinv02Puch2uJAtD4hpMe60FshYyIhxscDiElweFHWHG_n8QB6YSEfTrY12ATOPcHVL086b7GXWdpy1dzqZm6g6Id4gertmexPjx5hSysO3PMLECkoCDtDu-CfFI1h40JFv6ZBHQgAi208nZfZf6V6xgvrcxGhdrDkhN89bnMdcnhvRhvx9wPbL2BWRIeiz5Wl_CQ5VCD0OiLm4c5_dxm1Fm5JPsBuWzhV-CiuMw86fKB2w0eYVf8uHh5f1ETVa7yt7KU0hQNVEw8eFUFMjFmFZA0OivWxb7GA%3D%3D) For our children, Bill Gray, '01 Vice President Institutional Advancement Hillsdale College

* HOW it relates to current issues and events; and

And we must do this work without ONE PENNY of federal or state taxpayer support, even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. Instead, we put our trust in citizens like you who want what's best for the country. subject: Today is the day!
body:
Polls are NOW OPEN | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/voteadammorgan/election-day?e=0c28832e87)
---
[](https://voteadammorgan.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f7bd623e292b79126690dd777&id=bb69e3c215&e=0c28832e87)
| **TODAY IS THE DAY!**
---
| Polls are**now open** across the district. They close tonight at 7!
Need to know where to vote? Find it [here](https://voteadammorgan.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f7bd623e292b79126690dd777&id=c7534bbc25&e=0c28832e87).
Want to see a sample ballot for the races in your precinct? Get that [here](https://voteadammorgan.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f7bd623e292b79126690dd777&id=fc4336106a&e=0c28832e87).
Today is the day the Fourth Congressional District selects the Republican nominee for Congress.
As a candidate, I’ve been to forums, events, and doors across the district listening and talking to you—the voters I want to represent in Congress.
I’ve made promises standing on your doorstep—and I will keep those promises like I kept the promises I made to the voters in Taylors and Greenville’s Eastside when they elected me to serve them in 2018—and then reelected me in 2020 and 2022.
I want to represent your values in Congress. We’re blessed to call the Upstate home and our values are challenged on every side. I will fight to protect our values, secure our border, cut spending and end the weaponization of government against its citizens. I look forward to fighting to enact conservative America First policies with President Trump and the Republican majority in the U.S. House.
If you’ve already voted, please contact your friends and neighbors and urge them to vote for Adam Morgan for Congress.
I’m honored to have been endorsed by so many [conservative leaders](https://voteadammorgan.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f7bd623e292b79126690dd777&id=6d32a6a6cc&e=0c28832e87) across our nation, state and district—but the most important endorsement I can ask for is yours.
If you’re voting today, I humbly ask for your consideration and vote.

As the popularity of Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies continues to grow, so do the risks associated with theft and hacking. To protect your digital assets, it's crucial to take proactive steps to safeguard your Bitcoin. This article provides essential tips to help you prevent your Bitcoin from being stolen.
1. Use a Hardware Wallet: Hardware wallets are physical devices that store your private keys offline, providing a high level of security against online threats. These wallets are immune to computer viruses and malware, making them an excellent choice for long-term storage of significant amounts of Bitcoin. Popular hardware wallets include Ledger Nano S, Trezor, and Bitkey.
2. Enable Two-Factor Authentication (2FA): Two-factor authentication adds an extra layer of security to your Bitcoin wallet or exchange account. With 2FA enabled, you'll need to provide a second form of verification, such as a one-time code sent to your mobile device, to access your account or initiate transactions. This makes it much harder for hackers to compromise your account.
3. Keep Your Software Up to Date: Regularly update your wallet software and operating system to ensure you have the latest security patches and features. Outdated software may contain vulnerabilities that hackers can exploit to access your Bitcoin.
4. Use Strong and Unique Passwords: Create a strong, unique password for each of your wallets and accounts. Avoid using the same password across multiple platforms, as this can make it easier for hackers to access your accounts if one of them is compromised. Use a password manager to securely store and manage your passwords.
5. Be Cautious of Phishing Attempts: Always double-check the sender's identity and the legitimacy of the request when receiving emails or messages asking for your private keys or other sensitive information. Phishing scams are designed to trick you into revealing your private keys or login credentials, so be vigilant and never share this information with anyone.
6. Diversify Your Storage: Avoid storing all your Bitcoin in one place. Instead, spread your assets across multiple wallets and storage solutions to minimize the risk of losing everything in a single security breach. Consider using a combination of hardware wallets, paper wallets, and cold storage solutions for maximum security.
7. Keep Your Private Keys Offline: Never store your private keys on a device connected to the internet. If your private keys are compromised, your Bitcoin can be stolen. Store your private keys in a secure location, such as a physical safe or a safety deposit box, and never share them with anyone. It is interesting to me that the most sophisticated high tech currency must be protected with the old fashioned, low tech, pen and paper!
8. Use Multi-Signature Wallets: Multi-signature wallets require multiple signatures from different private keys to authorize transactions. This adds an extra layer of security and reduces the risk of theft, as a hacker would need to compromise multiple private keys to access your Bitcoin.
9. Regularly Monitor Your Accounts: Keep an eye on your Bitcoin wallets and exchange accounts for any unusual activity or unauthorized transactions. If you notice anything suspicious, report it immediately to your wallet provider or exchange and take steps to secure your account.
10. Educate Yourself: Stay informed about the latest security threats and best practices for protecting your Bitcoin. Follow reputable sources of information, such as cryptocurrency news websites and security experts, to stay up-to-date on the latest developments in the cryptocurrency space.

Protecting your Bitcoin from theft requires a proactive approach to security. One aspect of Bitcoin that draws many is the fact that you are independent and safe from the control of government. But, with that independence comes an understanding that no one is there to protect you if you make a mistake.
By following these essential tips, you can significantly reduce the risk of losing your digital assets to hackers and thieves. Remember to stay vigilant, keep your software and security measures up to date, and always be cautious when sharing sensitive information online.

body:
Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi there,
This is the Mountain Minute for Tuesday June 11, 2024.
- Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
| | **TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
---
**[What's on my ballot? Reviewing the candidates for U.S. Representative](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
While there will be five Democrat and four Republican positions for [U.S. Representative](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) unopposed, many voters around the state will have decisions to make for the office.
[Election Day is Tuesday, June 25.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Registered voters should have received a mailed ballot or will in the coming days. Those Coloradans who are not yet registered to vote may do so in a couple of ways with various deadlines. Register at GoVoteColorado.gov through June 17, in order to receive a ballot by mail. Additionally, registration can be completed in person at a voting center until 7 p.m. on Election Day.
Colorado elects members in [eight districts](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to the U.S. House of Representatives. Read this district-by-district breakdown of what you'll see on your ballot for this year's [primary election](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) based upon your registration with a major party or as an unaffiliated voter.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Jeffco GOP chief aims to force vote to remove Dave Williams as Colorado Republican Party chairman](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado Republican Party Chairman Dave Williams sent an email denigrating Pride Month and the LGBTQ community, sparking [significant backlash from within the party](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), including calls for his resignation from prominent GOP members like state Senator Barb Kirkmeyer.
* Pallozzi launched a petition to force a [vote on Williams' removal](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), citing his inappropriate use of state GOP funds and his divisive leadership. Removal requires a special meeting called by 25% of the GOP central committee, followed by a 60% majority vote.
* Many in the party, including several Republican congressional candidates and state party officials, have supported or signed the petition. By noon on Saturday following the launch, the required signatures to call the meeting [had been gathered](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
* Despite the controversy, Williams has stated he [will not resign](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and plans to continue his current approach, framing his actions as a defense against liberal agendas.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Hunter Biden won't testify, defense rests in federal gun trial](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE WASHINGTON TIMES](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Hunter Biden chose [not to testify](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) in his federal gun trial, and his defense team concluded their presentation after just one week. The prosecution's rebuttal included testimony from FBI agent Erica Jensen about text messages related to Hunter Biden's drug dealings, which the defense argued were inconclusive.
* [Closing arguments](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) are set to begin, following the defense's brief case which included three witnesses and contrasting with the prosecution's more extensive witness list over three days.
* Hunter faces [three felony charges](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) that could result in up to 25 years in prison for lying on a gun purchase form and illegally possessing a gun while being a drug user.
* The decision against Hunter Biden testifying avoided potential intensive cross-examination about his drug addiction and other legal issues, including an upcoming [trial on tax evasion](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Marijuana sales have plunged in Colorado and it is making other states nervous for future](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [POLITICO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado's cannabis market is facing [significant declines](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), with businesses closing or downsizing due to a $700 million drop in sales from its peak in 2020, impacting state finances and tax revenues.

* [Regulatory challenges](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), an oversaturated market, and increased competition from states with new legal markets are major factors contributing to the downturn.

* The spread of [cheap, unregulated intoxicating hemp-derived products](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and federal restrictions have further exacerbated competitive and financial pressures on the state's cannabis industry.

* Other states are observing Colorado's market challenges closely, using it as a [cautionary tale](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to pace their market growth and regulatory measures.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Unaffiliated voters up, party registrations down in reliably red Phillips County](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [HOLYOKE ENTERPRISE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* As of January 1, 2024, Phillips County, Colorado had 2,777 active voters, with [unaffiliated voters](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) reaching over 1,000 for the first time, indicating a 64% increase since the 2016 presidential election.
* Republicans still form the majority with 1,437 active voters despite a [9% decrease since 2017](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), while Democrats have significantly dropped to 299, a 30% decrease from their 2017 numbers.
* Trends show a substantial rise in the proportion of unaffiliated voters from 29% in 2020 to 36% in 2024, reflecting a[ broader state trend](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) where unaffiliated voters nearly equal the combined total of Democrats and Republicans.
* Phillips County's experience with [Proposition 108](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) illustrates local resistance to statewide electoral reforms, with 64% voting against the proposition which allows unaffiliated voters to participate in major party primaries without declaring party affiliation.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Ganahl: Free speech is not the enemy of progress](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY HEIDI GANAHL, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) | COMMENTARY
_On Wednesday, Colorado Governor Jared Polis signed Senate Bill 24-084 into law, effectively creating what some might call the state 's own Ministry of Truth. The bill, supposedly aimed at preventing the spread of misinformation and disinformation, establishes a partnership between the state attorney general and the Education Department. It's designed to reduce "factually inaccurate data" and "encourage respectful discourse."_
_Despite the Biden administration 's failure to establish a similar federal agency, those who wish to use government power to control what constitutes fake news and truth seem undeterred._
_Proponents of the bill, of course, assure us that it 's not about suppressing viewpoints. State Sen. Lisa Cutter, a Democrat, insisted, "No one is trying to curtail free speech--on the contrary. And I want to remind people this is a study, not legislation allowing the AG to determine anything."_
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️**
**[50 Cent goes to Capitol Hill and meets Colorado Rep. Lauren Boebert](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY BRIAN PORTER | NATIONAL | JUNE 6** _U.S. Rep. Lauren Boebert, R-Silt, was among the lawmakers to visit with rap artist 50 Cent on Wednesday during a visit to Capitol Hill_
**[Stratford: What does human trafficking look like in Colorado?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY SABRINA STRATFORD** **| STATE | JUNE 4** _There are more than 49.6 million people in modern slavery today. What does that look like in Colorado?_
**[Primary Election'24: In 5th District, both Democratic and Republican races are opposed](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY BRIAN PORTER**** | STATE | JUNE 4** _In Colorado 's 5th District, both Republican and Democratic registered voters will be asked to weigh in on contested races for their party's nomination to the general election ballot._

| | | Following Donald Trump's conviction on 34 counts, New Jersey is considering whether Trump should lose his liquor licenses for 3 golf courses in that state. This should be an [easy call](https://default.salsalabs.org/T09a1bfb9-94b1-4fa9-926c-4f83f6fe7f95/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9): 1) State law prohibits anyone from holding a liquor licenses who has been convicted of a crime "involving moral turpitude." and 2) Part of what goes into that calculation is a requirement that "a person must have a reputable character and would be expected to operate the licensed business in a reputable manner,'' according to the division. ([source](https://default.salsalabs.org/T0fb1ef39-b251-403b-bc34-ad5f25f47796/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)) **There is no way Trump passes this test. New Jersey has the right -- and the obligation -- to act now. And other states should follow.** [**Add your name, and urge NJ authorities to take away Trump's liquor licenses.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T5d313ba7-d796-4e21-a6f0-8732f73d5ce6/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

subject: New Legal Strategy Starting to Show Results
body:
|
---
| |
---
| | RITE’s Marshal Trigg recently wrote for the Daily Caller about how RITE has led a dramatic shift in election law litigation strategy, turning 2020 loses into 2024 victories.

Trigg writes, _**“Legislation has been tightened, highly skilled lawyers have taken over cases, COVID hysteria is gone and there are far fewer legal justifications for evading the core issues in the courtroom.”**_

Read the entire column at [The Daily Caller](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=2704ea7999&e=ea91f782ea).

**The Latest from RITE**

**KANSAS: Top Court Backs Signature Requirement and Limits on Ballot Harvesting**

In League of Women Voters v. Schwab, the Kansas Supreme Court affirmed the constitutionality of Kansas’ ballot harvesting restrictions and upheld the legislature's authority to require signature verification for mail-in ballots. RITE, in its brief to the court, argued against the notion that ballot harvesting is a fundamental right and emphasized the need for robust regulation in mail-in voting to address the increased opportunity for fraud. ([Read More](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=09ac175743&e=ea91f782ea))

**NEW YORK: Rite-Backed Plaintiffs Appeal Constitutional Challenge to Mail-Voting Law To State’s Highest Court**

RITE is appealing its challenge to New York’s mail-in voting law to the New York Court of Appeals. The court will have to make a legacy-defining decision on whether its state constitution carries any authority or if its merely subject to partisan whims. The RITE-backed coalition has argued for months that New York needed to amend its constitution before implementing no-excuse mail-in voting. Last year, Governor Hochul upended two hundred years of precedent and signed into law Albany’s end-run around its own constitution that requires, with limited exceptions, voting in person. ([Read More](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=0191be0aa4&e=ea91f782ea))

**WISCONSIN: Elias Stopped by RITE Argument Defending State’s Mail Ballot Witness Requirement**

A federal court in Wisconsin rejected activist-attorney Marc Elias's attempt to block the state's requirement for mail voters to have a witness confirm their compliance with voting laws. The court's opinion decisively rejected Elias's legal argument, observing that it simply does not make sense. The defeated litigants have twenty-nine days to decide whether to test their arguments with the Court of Appeals. ([Read More](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=a8d603f67f&e=ea91f782ea))

**PENNSYLVANIA: Data Collection Scheme Masked to be Voter Registration Drive**

RITE is demanding records from the Pennsylvania Department of State in response to reports that left-wing activists are using software to operate a voter registration website mimicking the Commonwealth’s official voter registration website. RITE pointed out that the imposter website has questionable data privacy policies and may not operate in line with official guidelines. RITE made the inquiry to help the public understand the data collection practices of potentially unscrupulous third parties and ensure the program is secure and legally compliant. ([Read More](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=0a7a826f8d&e=ea91f782ea))

**MICHIGAN: Litigating to Ensure State Removes Dead Registered Voters**

RITE filed a [brief](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=d942dfa4d5&e=ea91f782ea) supporting an allied organization in a federal appellate court arguing that Michigan Secretary of State Jocelyn Benson has violated federal law by failing to make “reasonable” efforts to remove deceased voters from the state’s voter registration list.

**MONTANA: Defending Legislation to Prevent and Remove Duplicate Voter Registrations**

RITE filed a [brief](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=306b168f16&e=ea91f782ea) supporting the state of Montana and the Republican National Committee in defending legislation attacked by the left that ensures the state can remove those who are registered in both Montana and another state or who have duplicate registrations within the state.

This is the email of a lifetime.

And not something I ever thought I'd be sending.

It's Steve Garvey - First Baseman and World Series Champion.

I'm now officially Adam Schiff's (remember him?) opponent in the California U.S. Senate race.

You know the corporate media has already written me off & said that I have no chance to win.

_**They hate people like us.**_

When I was growing up, my parents owned a bar right across the street from The Holiday, Pittsburgh’s oldest gay bar.
At a time when the gay community was under constant threat and forced to hide, the owners, Chuck and Chuck, were my parents' friends and neighbors in the most ordinary way.
When I would run across the street to borrow some ice, seeing gay people simply being themselves taught me important lessons about love and acceptance — and also reminded me how they had so few places where they could be open and feel safe.
When I look back on the strides the LGBTQ+ community has made in demanding — and winning — equal rights and acceptance, I think back to the people at the Holiday who simply wanted to be true to themselves and the people they loved.
For too long, members of the LGBTQ+ community in Pennsylvania have not been afforded the rights and protections they deserve. That’s why I’m going to work tirelessly every day as your next Attorney General to protect and expand LGBTQ+ freedoms in every way I can.

name: Ruben Gallego
subject: I really need your help if we’re going to take back Arizona’s Senate seat
disclaimer_text: Paid for by The Long Run PAC, P
body:
When I was serving in the Marines, I never thought I’d be in this position. On patrol in Al Anbar, Iraq, I was about as far from Congress as you can get.
#
Friend —
I’ve got to be honest with you. I never thought this is how it’d go.
When I was sleeping on the floor of our apartment, I never thought I’d be running for Senate someday. All I knew was that I was going to have to work my butt off to get into a good school — after that, I had no idea.
When I was serving in the Marines, I never thought I’d be in this position. On patrol in Al Anbar, Iraq, I was about as far from Congress as you can get.

\*\*_GET TO KNOW CURTIS_\*\*

\*\*Curtis Bashaw is a hotel entrepreneur, job creator, and preservationist. He's running for United States Senate to provide greater freedom and opportunities for all New Jerseyans.\*\*

A lifelong New Jersey resident, Curtis grew up in Camden County and spent his summers at the Jersey Shore working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. He has spent his life in the real estate and hospitality industries, and is the Founder and Managing Partner of Cape Resorts, a hotel company focusing on the restoration and operation of classic American resort properties in New Jersey and New York.

Throughout his career, Curtis has worked to build communities and bring people together. He is widely recognized for leading the landmark restorations of Congress Hall and the Virginia Hotel in Cape May, and for launching creative programming to dramatically extend Cape May's season, a catalyst for the economic rebirth of one of the Jersey Shore's most beautiful communities.

Curtis is a successful businessman and job creator, employing more than 1,000 people in New Jersey and New York. Curtis' company owns and operates eight hotels, ten cottages, six restaurants, four retail outlets and a working farm, all on the Jersey Shore and Long Island's East End. Curtis lives in Cape May with his husband, Will.

subject: Support This Woman’s Fight Against Retaliation
body:
DEI is thinly disguised racism.

| | | [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z28uujavehhujlofcjkf3ho6rdph1f5qaau2jcno_rp22sh2s8i6ep30shh6eo32cdh2bs)
---
| |
Dear Friend of Liberty,

I wanted to bring to your attention a critical issue that affects us all.

Recently, Danielle Johnson bravely took a stand against DEI and discriminatory practices within her company, the Oregon Department of Environmental Quality.

However, when she merely questioned these racist DEI practices, she was called a racist in an all-company e-mail, had her pay cut, and was demoted.

DEI is thinly disguised racism. Danielle spoke up against it and now is fighting back by suing her employer.

This fight, however, isn't just about Danielle--it's about you, too. When her right to free speech is in danger, yours is also at risk. We cannot stand and watch as our fundamental rights are destroyed.

At Mountain States Legal Foundation, we are committed to supporting Danielle in her pursuit of justice. But we cannot do it without your help.

**[Your signature will not only help defend Danielle and her constitutional rights, but it will also empower us to fight similar battles down the line, securing a freer America for every one of us.](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z70hvho0483nol6mpblsreqllb52o8q78rqvirk8_rp22sh2s8i6ep30shh6eo32cdh2bs)**

Please take a moment to sign our petition and join us in demanding the accountability and transparency that we deserve from our government.

Please sign our petition now: [https://mslegal.org/subscribe/johnson-petition/](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2za9mdnojg6in8imvplq1vijp4kku4nmururnvfmo_rp22sh2s8i6ep30shh6eo32cdh2bs).

For Liberty!

Cristen Wohlgemuth

Could you imagine the heartbreak of seeing your child’s potential limited by the quality of their education or the lack of local vocational training?
Unfortunately, all forms of vocational training have been slowly disappearing from public schools. But together, we can change that.
drbob.me/aboutbob [drbob.me/aboutbob]

Friends,
Each of us has a role to play in ensuring that every child has the opportunity to learn, grow, and succeed.
Federally, this requires investment, initiative, focus, and a congressional leader willing to champion alternative educational paths.
A quality education can mean something other than attending a traditional four-year university. We want students to follow their passions , and we need skilled workers to keep our economy running smoothly.
Vocational training, trade schools, community colleges, and apprenticeships offer practical, hands-on experience and specialized skills in high demand. We can also start students' training early by cultivating their skills in middle school and high school.

Elissa is a bit of a data nerd, so we wanted to explain what losing better actually means in terms of numbers:
In Elissa’s 2022 House race, we won because we were able to turn out voters in places Democrats normally struggle.
Clinton County: in 2022, Elissa lost by 3.2%. In 2020, the top of the ticket lost it by 6.5%.

Shiawassee County: we lost by 14%. Other Democrats lost it by 20% two years earlier.
That’s what we like to call “losing better.” It means doing better in “red” parts of the state than most Democrats do.

Congressmen Ryun and Tiahrt endorse trusted and tested conservative Kahrs | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/jeffkahrsforcongress/ryun-and-tiahrt-endorse-kahrs-for-congress?e=790c5fa456)

|
# ENDORSEMENT ALERT!
Dear ,
I wanted to make sure you saw the news. Two former Congressmen who represented Kansas in Congress are throwing their support behind my campaign. Congressman Jim Ryun represented the Kansas Second Congressional District in Congress from 1997-2007.
“Jeff Kahrs is a true America First conservative who will make us proud in Kansas. He is exactly the kind of commonsense conservative that should be representing Kansas. His Christian faith, determination to protect our republic’s constitution, her borders, and commitment to rooting out the cultural rot of transgender ideology that is attempting to transform our country will serve Kansas and our nation well. Anne and I offer Jeff our full support. We urge you to vote for Jeff Kahrs for Congress,” Ryun said.
He and his wife Anne are movement conservatives who represented Kansas and our shared conservative values well in Washington, D.C.
[Sign the petition so everyone knows you stand with Jeff, because we need to send another conservative warrior to Congress.](https://jeffkahrsforcongress.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=16c344decd50f8373779db4a0&id=e94d3d86bd&e=790c5fa456)
---
[I’m with Jim and Jeff!](https://jeffkahrsforcongress.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=16c344decd50f8373779db4a0&id=4e984c538a&e=790c5fa456)
| Congressman Todd Tiahrt and his wife, Vicki, also offered their support for my campaign. Tiahrt served in Congress from 1995-2011. I worked for Todd as his chief of staff and top adviser in his Washington office.
“When Jeff Kahrs was my Chief of Staff and top adviser, I counted on him to effectively lead, to be the conservative backbone of my team, and to fight for our conservative legislation to win. As the only American First candidate in this race, Jeff will serve the Second District well. Jeff has my full support, and at this critical time, Vicki and I strongly urge you to vote for him,” Tiahrt said.
[Sign the petition so everyone knows you stand with Jeff, because we need to send another conservative warrior to Congress.](https://jeffkahrsforcongress.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=16c344decd50f8373779db4a0&id=596bf05aee&e=790c5fa456)
---
[I’m with Todd and Jeff!](https://jeffkahrsforcongress.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=16c344decd50f8373779db4a0&id=18e847e4e1&e=790c5fa456)
| Jim and Todd were conservative warriors in Congress. They know our state and love our nation, and I am honored that they are willing to put their trust in me. Conservatives in Washington and in Kansas know that I’m the only trusted and true conservative in this race.
That’s why I have the support of former Governor Sam Brownback, CPAC, and now former Congressmen Ryun and Tiahrt. I’m hoping to earn your support as well.
**Can I count on you to vote for the only trusted and tested conservative in this race?**
I’m building a conservative army, but I can’t do it alone. Will you sign the petition and let me know that you stand with conservatives in Washington and Kansas and stand with me?
---
