Any idea that there was a cover-up is just absurd and false. The truth is that the Benghazi Committee wouldn't have been successful in uncovering Hillary's 30,000 emails, rampant corruption, and her failure to keep Americans safe without the work Mike Rogers did."** — Former Trump Secretary of State Mike Pompeo Sandy Pensler released another new TV [Ad](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=e03100a262ea4a2fb420df031bde36d8&_e=XI1iDD6jHJLX4vz6Qa9hvpraoyirfQGXLKf4LcPHLxUu0qXO82ONWgdgcXV51j3nye3vIjFIiFs1r9o0JGMVjp0cOwzWf11-l4gnd-RZy6b9X2174zlggwBQgO2IeNFZUqDV6F10Pfrx0w21qOD1mJmb6IuS5S-9UjnE5hg-8btXAHb-Tbr6l8cECSOPBo7uOi6ixN2pw5vyp0ACyBwGW2wnR1THmgdKRlIBrIQRUZk%3D) on Monday, filled with the same baseless allegations and lies as his [ad](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=e03100a262ea4a2fb420df031bde36d8&_e=XI1iDD6jHJLX4vz6Qa9hvjjbGuRUeNHW2r7Q23OS-Q0OkEiso5IyfFD4OZeXqTQrP92_2n3zD5kgpNxcd8QQVyOZhf8E-OhC2BAKCbSVdXnDItQUzn1gIgbFTaJ9eJ4Z-by4DY2QOizhiItOU2VkPYBm7VBtCBIyS2Qdy-tM4mvR0HH1mZbcGx6baBpKlC2RO8wy4dteiuIr158epk6Q9kxAtb46X_tUSCE8-pbYjmo%3D) last month. Just as last time, Pensler is making egregious and unsubstantiated claims that Mike Rogers participated in covering up actions taken by Hillary Clinton surrounding the attack on the U.S. Embassy in Benghazi on September 11, 2012. **_This couldn’t be further from the truth._** Pensler - polling below 5 percent - has made it abundantly clear that he is so wildly out of touch that he has zero grasp of the issues that Michigan families are facing today. He has continually run ads that are misleading and completely irrelevant in 2024. This sad attempt to disparage Mike Rogers is simply further evidence of Pensler’s mission to do whatever he can to work against President Trump and strong conservative candidates in Michigan by espousing nonsensical lies to save his failed campaign. These claims are nothing more than fringe conspiracy theories cooked up by Democrat research firms.
There is strong evidence these television ads are having no effect, and in fact have only received fierce criticism. As an example, see below for a transcript from Detroit’s preeminent radio station WJR 760 AM [discussing the absurdity](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=e03100a262ea4a2fb420df031bde36d8&_e=XI1iDD6jHJLX4vz6Qa9hvuUqvZN4Z6zs6MPlHRHskZ2mAIr-I2j9WzM7nn5jzG472F-Uw8iaZLk03KfcBauLB9l1k1spZAuAN81xTT_5pN8YQRn1h7Nh6_is0zmNZJSASDGN_AR_dEE_ZyjvYCgAuP4EIrejuv2ObdpIHs4jZqG5VSumvM6m92ScUU8c98bBUMDwji6i8UB0EapHAQB2lJC0cGU1IhFyrMr2IJvuxDatvKejFPfaZXT5rcm7R59d1aa0Xqdc45EKFcky31o5_w%3D%3D) of the ad:
---
**“It was September 11, 2012, and the U.S. embassy in Benghazi was attacked and we lost lives. It was Christopher Stevens, who was killed in this back then, and to tie Mike Rogers, who was part of the investigative team, to this attack now, only that it is an election year, I mean that is a low blow I think to Sandy Pensler...”** **“He shouldn’t have done that ... that somehow Mike Rogers is not a Republican, only in name, is disingenuous, it’s not true. He’s endorsed by Donald Trump, he’s endorsed by Mike Pompeo, who was on the leadership of the Benghazi select committee at the time as well, this is I think disingenuous and I think it’s hurtful.”**
---
**That being said, it is important to debunk the nonsense and set the record straight:** As Chairman of the House Intelligence Committee, Mike Rogers led an investigation into the events leading up to, during, and following the attack on the U.S. Embassy in Benghazi on September 11, 2012. The scope of the House Intel investigation was limited to the 17 agencies of the Intelligence Community, of which the House Intel Committee has oversight. Parallel investigations were conducted by Congressional Committees with oversight authority of the Department of State and Department of Defense. The House Intel investigation was **STRICTLY** delineated to establish if there were any intelligence failures leading up to September 11, 2012, by the intelligence agencies, and to establish a timeline of events that took place. The Foreign Affairs Committee report had jurisdiction over the actions of the State Department, therefore Mike's report certainly didn't clear Hillary Clinton of wrongdoing. In fact, it pointed out numerous failures at the State Department, and as a result, Mike co-sponsored and voted for the establishment of the House Benghazi Select Committee to pursue further investigations into the failures leading up to September 11, 2012. As Chairman, Mike submitted additional views as part of his Benghazi report, and stated the following:
---
_“Senior State Department officials dismissed repeated threats, warnings, and denied requests for additional security in eastern Libya, thereby placing U.S. personnel at unnecessary risk. Senior U.S. officials perpetuated an inaccurate story that matched the Administration’s misguided view that the U.S. was nearing a victory over al-Qa’ida. The Administration’s failed policies continue to undermine the national security interests of the United States.”_
---
Mike also authored an [op-ed in The Hill](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=e03100a262ea4a2fb420df031bde36d8&_e=XI1iDD6jHJLX4vz6Qa9hvrhFK_k8Fj9Blg9_V7JhBOwoYIJzYfNI84ivxwX90Ll9GA7FrwuCY4Z2_mCCwtgYRnR4yOTmClweL--hJ8KPEKLFRkMfd_ikZy2bAlkJ8NQcWoZHp9DVF66IS1mkpPtxaW5VbHaL5zjHByxs2c3ryciPzvM-4y9ssfW60oF8YeCluvCBM_sbdxNgjwHch7NvmdP0SO8GgFhkKUKolJ_f5lpHVR3WvZh6ANKK02jjjx1rnZAAtOStZY8xiN857ipKvvh639NNMTPWnfn9zRonqIo%3D) in December 2014 after the report was submitted and stated:
---
_“The Obama administration’s White House and State Department actions before, during, and after the Benghazi terrorist attack on September 11, 2012, ranged from incompetence to deplorable political manipulation in the midst of an election season._ _The State Department ignored numerous, consistent intelligence warnings about the threat environment in Benghazi and was woefully unprepared to operate in a high threat environment like Benghazi. _ _For months after the attacks, senior White House officials, including President Obama, grossly misled the American people about what happened and why. I believe that they did this to further their own inaccurate view that they had al Qa’ida ‘on the run’; and with an election looming they did not want to be responsible for a terrorist attack on their watch.”_
---
This full investigation by the House Benghazi Select Committee eventually uncovered substantial misdeeds by Hillary Clinton, including the use of her private email server and revelations about the over 30,000 plus emails that she had deleted, which in part helped sink her political aspirations in 2016. Please see below for an endorsement of Mike Rogers from former Secretary of State Mike Pompeo who served on both the Intelligence Committee and Benghazi Select Committee, as well as a statement from the Rogers Campaign. **Former Secretary of State Mike Pompeo:**
---
"Mike Rogers is the leader we need in the United States Senate. Mike served our nation in the Army and fought unabashedly for a strong America in Congress, and during my own service on the House Intelligence Committee, he showed incredible leadership as its Chairman. As a Senator, Mike Rogers will continue to confront the historic threat posed by the Chinese Communist Party and be an indispensable leader in keeping America safe and secure. He has my full support, and I hope the good people of Michigan will join me.”
---
**Rogers Campaign Communications Director, Chris Gustafson:**
---
“Mike Pompeo called these ads ‘absurd and false’ and he’s right, if you have to lie to get someone’s vote, you don’t deserve it. With cheap ads and wildly out of touch attempts to smear Mike, it’s no wonder Sandy has already been soundly defeated twice before. There’s a reason President Trump endorsed Mike Rogers, he’s the only one talking about real solutions for Michigan families on the issues that actually matter. The truth is Mike’s work allowed the facts about Hillary Clinton’s failures that preceded that tragic day to come to light, which resulted in exposing her secret servers and 30,000 deleted emails.”
---
**State of the Race:**
---
Mike Rogers continues to hold a commanding lead over the other Republican candidates in the race, with the RCP average showing him up 21% on his nearest primary opponent. In the latest June 1st poll, Mike Rogers leads his next closest primary competitor, Justin Amash, by 21%, and Sandy Pensler by 26%.
---
---
The general election for Michigan’s U.S. Senate race is in a dead heat. Recent polling continues to show that Mike Rogers is statistically tied with his likely Democrat opponent, Elissa Slotkin, among general election voters. Mike’s strong performance has made Michigan the only targeted race in the country that’s within the margin of error.
---
---
**Grassroots Support:**
---
Mike has been traveling the state and attending local Republican events to build a strong grassroots network and is the only candidate in the race committed to running a robust ground game that is essential to Republicans being successful in Michigan this year. **Mike is endorsed by President Donald J. Trump and Secretary of State Mike Pompeo** , and has endorsements from important Michigan conservative leaders**including Congressmen Tim Walberg and Jack Bergman, Congresswoman Lisa McClain, Former Detroit Police Chief James Craig, and former Congresswoman Candice Miller.** **Mike Rogers has clearly defined himself as Michigan’s Law & Order candidate**, being endorsed by the Police Officers Association of Michigan, over 30 Michigan County Sheriffs, the Southeast and Oakland County Chiefs of Police Associations, and numerous state and local law enforcement officers throughout the state.

name: Matt Diemer
subject: Representation
body:
| |
---
Peter, What is a representative? Representatives come from every corner of America, symbolizing a wide range of constituencies and working to solve issues that may or may not be unique to their particular part of the country. In short: A representative does just that — represents. A representative should consider the whole of their district when voting on issues — not just the private interests that fund their campaign or those in their political corner. Understanding the district from top to bottom and right to left is paramount to true representation. Representatives are meant to bring their district to DC — the unique ideas and experiences from your area — and contribute those to the conversation of legislation. You'd build consensus and move things forward. This is what our system was envisioned to do. Now, however, we have the Ds and Rs, the red vs. blue, the left vs. right, legislating for all America regardless of its diversity or regional uniqueness. It's wrong, and we need to fix this. When you elect me to represent you, I promise this: ✅ I am not your leader. I am your representative. ✅ I will be the voice of our district in DC, not the factions that have emerged. ✅ I will put policy for ALL over politics. This is how we move to build a more perfect union. Hello,
I want to take a moment to share my views on an under-discussed issue in our country: improving the state of public education.
Our forefathers knew that public education was the key to a strong Republic. Public education has been a great opportunity to level the playing field, so that all citizens have a more equal opportunity to succeed and achieve the American dream.
Public education teaches the similar concepts that most of our society is based upon for individuals to become autonomous adults who can function and make their own way through our ever-changing society. The fundamental building blocks of reading, writing, math and social interaction help to instill and create a national unity based on values, principles and techniques that make American workers the great workforce that we are.
However, we can do better. According to the Century Foundation, US schools are underfunded by nearly $150 billion per year. Our community schools are especially underfunded, and our kids deserve better. We must invest in our public education system to ensure tomorrow’s future.
You get what you pay for and if we are unwilling to invest the time, the energy, the talent, and the finances to ensure that students have the skills they need to remain the strongest and best country in the world. We cannot continue to settle for the underfunding and the intentional neglect of our public education system.

| | | Hi folks, can I share something with you? When I came out in college, I knew I was interested in a career in public service. But I feared that I would have to face a serious choice between pursuing the field of my dreams or living my authentic life openly.
---
|

After seeing others in the LGBTQ+ community demonstrate acts of courage by coming out, being themselves, and being public about who they are and who they love, I came to realize that I could do both:
**I could run for office and be honest about who I am — so that’s exactly what I did.** When I became the first openly gay Senator elected in our nation’s history, I understood that I needed to use this extraordinary opportunity to make a difference in people's lives. From lowering prescription drug prices to protecting same-sex marriage through the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , I’ve worked hard every day since to do just that. That's why I ran for office in the first place — not to make history, but to make a difference. And folks like you supported me because you wanted to make a difference, too. [** _I’m facing my most competitive and expensive reelection yet, so I can’t keep up this work with your help. **A Message from Senator John Barrasso:**

[](http://links.myfreedomnews.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=00f4c9061a804148948595dca75c49c4&_e=IvAwm3qw7PJgU-w-wH1OvpuJ5CA0tNl2GoVhubzGGpyr8A35QPQHXfqp2Fl_pOay-iooAxQpJ9XbrB89jKZ-sgDnnTOHHlZvV9SzmDMy1QNeihp0BDY3kYlWOqSnaVwt6oanS8Bzen20L6wixuFyUB3X8W74VQr3fe8_baOjlz3MhCX-nCvFvYiUNY0vfZK0XrCkPZW54_Q4B0F06V6fUOq7ZVTBlmBhzKO2OMXQrJCUc_l4OxbcvbHqAZ2hSzQGbjsX0Yh_JolSrYVcY9T0VQ%3D%3D)
I want to take a moment to remind you of my journey to the U.S. Senate, the important le ssons I have learned along the way, and why I continue to believe wholeheartedly in our beloved state.

My father, a World War II veteran, left school during the Great Depression to join the Army. Though he only had a ninth grade education, he built a career as a hard-working cement finisher. My mother, a dedicated voter who never missed an election, instilled in me the importance of civic duty.

From my parents, I inherited an unwavering love for this country that I have proudly carried throughout my life. It's something I strive to keep alive in Wyoming.

Later, in medical school, I learned the importance of having a plan before taking action, a lesson that has proven invaluable in both my medical career and my service as your senator. Just as in surgery, effective leadership requires a clear vision and a strategic approach to problem-solving.

As you may know, I am sometimes referred to as _"Wyoming's doctor,"_ but to be honest, that is what I have always strived to be as your senator. I have wholeheartedly dedicated myself to serving the state, addressing its challenges, and making it the best it can be.

**_Whether it's advocating for our veterans, championing American energy security, or safeguarding our borders, I've always strived to be a voice for all Wyoming people. Your concerns are my concerns, and your aspirations are my aspirations._**

As we look towards the future, I'm confident that Wyoming has the potential to be an even stronger, more prosperous state. **[But it will require strong leadership, a clear vision, and your continued support.](http://links.myfreedomnews.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=00f4c9061a804148948595dca75c49c4&_e=IvAwm3qw7PJgU-w-wH1OvpuJ5CA0tNl2GoVhubzGGpyr8A35QPQHXfqp2Fl_pOay-iooAxQpJ9XbrB89jKZ-sgDnnTOHHlZvV9SzmDMy1QNeihp0BDY3kYlWOqSnaVwt1X7cABvxfNOQBSHYEglquZQoGCRvAbde6FmBGKahdZF9wIxVNTD1Errfu6nxuWAx0ZiKy0tC6_VKUPXNFUXqvxqYa6q0kln9Kdenzhq1qQ9kU7IxdGLvTqMV4rAWPqB4HwkCq3G-_Rm8OY6MuNg9XQ%3D%3D)**

Already, your support has been instrumental in my journey, and I promise to continue fighting for the issues that matter most to Wyoming families.

Sincerely,
Senator John Barrasso [CHIP IN FOR A STRONG WYOMING](http://links.myfreedomnews.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=00f4c9061a804148948595dca75c49c4&_e=IvAwm3qw7PJgU-w-wH1OvpuJ5CA0tNl2GoVhubzGGpyr8A35QPQHXfqp2Fl_pOay-iooAxQpJ9XbrB89jKZ-sgDnnTOHHlZvV9SzmDMy1QNeihp0BDY3kYlWOqSnaVwtXmZ5i6vEzoh9RVu8_wP7iDLQjCi0V5pvcLQibShyIIOy3s5C2NPu5MJnJswB2XCr8tUdfkh1NyorXTGD5jlKYmxDMdamog9o6E7yBpzxrHW8rCj7eqEEl_-o8iYPknmJla5Suri49LrR7EvrGOBNgA%3D%3D)

| | Dear, Friend: From the outset, we knew that this campaign was about more than just one person—it was about all of us, coming together to advocate for our New Jersey values. Each of you has played a crucial role in our campaign—whether you knocked on doors, made phone calls, donated, or shared our message with friends and family—your contributions have made a significant impact. **THANK YOU!** With Tuesday’s victory, the stage is now set: It is us against Radical “Defund the Police” Activist, Sue Altman. Peter, When we look with despair at what's happening in Washington and also our state/local politics, I believe we're seeing the result of what happens when men and women with high moral character choose to bow out of the process.

Just look at how many honorable, respectable and compassionate leaders have either decided not to run for office or have resigned their elected positions sooner than expected. And many election workers and those who volunteer to work in our polling locations have had their physical security threatened, causing many of them to stop participating.

Many former elected officials have been replaced, in too many cases, by people who stoke outrage in their competition for attention with their base rather than working collaboratively to make a positive difference in the lives of their constituents or our country.

What really concerns me is how both sides are increasingly willing to use the levers of government as weapons to discredit or harm those they perceive as their enemies. This isn't necessarily new, but the intensity with which it's happening is alarming. Americans on the fringes of both parties are not only rooting for this madness, but also donating tens of millions of dollars to support an extreme agenda!

I spoke about this disturbing trend earlier this week during a recent interview. I hope you'll give it a listen and let me know what you think:

Just look at what's happening now with former President Trump being targeted, while in response his allies are loudly broadcasting their intentions of targeting Democrats.

Where does this end? Who exactly is this benefitting? I know that your answer isn't that all of this is good for America, because we both know it isn't.

It’s driving the people with strong moral character from running for office, and you know what? I don't blame them. Why would you want to enter public service today if you could face being ruined financially by having to defend yourself from the justice system being used as a weapon against you?

**I know you’ve heard me say this many times before, but I still believe that the solution is in our hands..._in your hands_**. By using our voices strongly, but peacefully and lawfully, and by casting a vote, we have the power to make a difference.

If you're as concerned as I am about the direction of our country, then let's stop sending candidates to Washington who lack high moral character and the courage to compromise.

I pray that our country can find in itself the wisdom and bravery to change direction. I'm not suggesting we should go backwards, but rather forward with daring and determination in a new direction. We desperately need new voices that have fresh ideas and a fearless commitment to serve the American people.

**Peter - the power is in your hands. What will you do with it?**

John

clean_body: I believe we're seeing the result of what happens when men and women with high moral character choose to bow out of the process.| | | Peter, When we look with despair at what's happening in Washington and also our state/local politics, I believe we're seeing the result of what happens when men and women with high moral character choose to bow out of the process. Just look at how many honorable, respectable and compassionate leaders have either decided not to run for office or have resigned their elected positions sooner than expected. And many election workers and those who volunteer to work in our polling locations have had their physical security threatened, causing many of them to stop participating. Many former elected officials have been replaced, in too many cases, by people who stoke outrage in their competition for attention with their base rather than working collaboratively to make a positive difference in the lives of their constituents or our country. What really concerns me is how both sides are increasingly willing to use the levers of government as weapons to discredit or harm those they perceive as their enemies. This isn't necessarily new, but the intensity with which it's happening is alarming. Americans on the fringes of both parties are not only rooting for this madness, but also donating tens of millions of dollars to support an extreme agenda! I spoke about this disturbing trend earlier this week during a recent interview. I hope you'll give it a listen and let me know what you think: "'Revenge and threats': House GOP pushes legislation to appease Trump" | | | ---|---|--- Just look at what's happening now with former President Trump being targeted, while in response his allies are loudly broadcasting their intentions of targeting Democrats. Where does this end? Who exactly is this benefitting? I know that your answer isn't that all of this is good for America, because we both know it isn't. It’s driving the people with strong moral character from running for office, and you know what? I don't blame them. Why would you want to enter public service today if you could face being ruined financially by having to defend yourself from the justice system being used as a weapon against you? I know you’ve heard me say this many times before, but I still believe that the solution is in our hands...in your hands. By using our voices strongly, but peacefully and lawfully, and by casting a vote, we have the power to make a difference. If you're as concerned as I am about the direction of our country, then let's stop sending candidates to Washington who lack high moral character and the courage to compromise. I pray that our country can find in itself the wisdom and bravery to change direction. I'm not suggesting we should go backwards, but rather forward with daring and determination in a new direction. We desperately need new voices that have fresh ideas and a fearless commitment to serve the American people. Peter - the power is in your hands. What will you do with it? John | | | Get the Latest Updates: | | | | ---|---|---|--- | | | | Paid for by Kasich for America, not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. www.JohnKasich.com

I just turned in a huge stack of petition signatures, which means I am officially running for reelection to the U.S. Senate!
I'm running for two main reasons:
1. We’re losing the middle in the Senate.
2. There’s a lot left to do.
In a Congress and nation that is deeply partisan, my position as an Independent has helped bridge the divide. And we’ve gotten some important things done in the last few years -–the CARES Act to send direct economic assistance to American families and businesses hurting during the COVID pandemic, the Great American Outdoors Act to protect our public lands, the PACT Act to expand benefits for our veterans, the $1.2 trillion Bipartisan Infrastructure bill, and the CHIPS and Science Act which has already resulted in an explosion of investment in bringing semiconductor manufacturing back home. All of these accomplishments were the result of bipartisan negotiation, debate, and compromise. And it’s that spirit of working together I'm afraid we’re losing.
Our work isn’t done. From the unsustainable cost of prescription drugs to the unacceptable attacks on reproductive rights, our nation is grappling with serious and complex issues.
I’m going to keep doing what I always have: encourage compassion and civility and try to bring people and politicians together across party lines to get things done. Here’s the deal, though: this won’t be possible without your support. Friend, would you consider becoming a Founding Donor to my reelection campaign by chipping in $10 or $20 today? | **_GET TO KNOW CURTIS_**

**Curtis Bashaw is a hotel entrepreneur, job creator, and preservationist. He's running for United States Senate to provide greater freedom and opportunities for all New Jerseyans.**

A lifelong New Jersey resident, Curtis grew up in Camden County and spent his summers at the Jersey Shore working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. He has spent his life in the real estate and hospitality industries, and is the Founder and Managing Partner of Cape Resorts, a hotel company focusing on the restoration and operation of classic American resort properties in New Jersey and New York.

Throughout his career, Curtis has worked to build communities and bring people together. He is widely recognized for leading the landmark restorations of Congress Hall and the Virginia Hotel in Cape May, and for launching creative programming to dramatically extend Cape May's season, a catalyst for the economic rebirth of one of the Jersey Shore's most beautiful communities.

Curtis is a successful businessman and job creator, employing more than 1,000 people in New Jersey and New York. 3-A904-E168017696C1&u=61372> : A Southern Border Disaster Reaches Up
North

ANCHORAGE, AK - In case you missed it, Alaska Lt. Governor Nancy
Dahlstrom penned an opinion piece with Townhall
<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=68919&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=61372> on her recent visit to the wide-open
southern border in Yuma, Arizona.

As the Biden-Peltola border crisis rages on with no end in sight and a
lackluster border order coming out of the White House, it has become
clear that the Democrats are derelict in their duty to secure America.
The open border has turned every state into a border state, including
Alaska, and is allowing the flow of fentanyl into the nation via cartel
smugglers.

In her piece, Dahlstrom notes that U.S. national security is in
jeopardy under the backwards policies of Joe Biden and Mary Peltola,
the brazenness of hundreds of illegal migrants crossing over
unfettered, and the food security crisis that can arise from the border
disaster.

"Everything I witnessed made it clear that Joe Biden and his Democrat
lackeys, like Mary Peltola, are failing our nation and Alaska by
leaving our border open," Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom wrote. "The
chaos and lack of leadership has led to 85,000 migrant children
unaccounted for, with fears they are currently being trafficked. We are
simply not equipped to handle this disaster, yet Democrats continue to
support policies that encourage illegal immigration and welcome these
criminals with open arms."

"Our security, prosperity, and safety are all at risk. As your
Congresswoman, my top priority will be to reinstate President Trump's
Remain in Mexico policy and finish the wall. Meanwhile, Mary Peltola
continues to side with President Biden and leave our border wide-open.
But now that it's an election year, she will try to cover up her record
on the border as she tries to cling to power."

# The Frederick Douglass Celebration
A Great American, A Great Republican
---
| **The Evening Could Not Have Been a Better Success**
---
|
---
|
A staggering 135 Republicans (and a few Democrats) descended upon Branford, CT to exalt the enduring legacy of Frederick Douglass. We proudly bestowed the inaugural Frederick Douglass Unity Award upon Mike Freda, the esteemed 1st Selectman of Branford. Furthermore, we unequivocally honored a distinguished Branford resident, a former Mr. Universe and Mr. America, with a well-deserved Lifetime Achievement Award.
**Chairman Ben Proto** addressed the sell-out crowd with a message of unity straight from the Frederick Douglass playbook, and **Andy Fowle** r of the Yankee Institute provided valuable insight into the importance of Frederick Douglass's teachings, especially in today's context.
All our **federal candidates** received a copy of "Telling the Truth" by KCarl Smith, an acclaimed author. This book focuses on integrating the message of Frederick Douglass into Republican campaigns.
The highlight of the evening was this quote by Mike Katz:
_**“I have never felt more like an American than I do tonight.”**_
Mission accomplished, now let’s get to work.
Dominic Rapini

# Why Frederick Douglass?
---
| **A Force for Uniting the United States:** Frederick Douglass serves as a powerful symbol for Republicans to promote the values and principles that make our nation unique. He was born into slavery in 1818, but later became one of the leading advocates for reuniting our nation as the Civil War came to an end. His strong conviction in the power of our founding values and constitutional principles, along with his self-learned eloquence, helped guide Abraham Lincoln and the recently formed Republican party to win a second term based on these values and principles. Lincoln faced the daunting challenge of rescuing a nation divided by the Civil War.
**Believed in American Principles:** History tells us that Lincoln's wholehearted embrace of Douglass's message of fighting for and preserving the values that formed our nation was not only the winning message, but also the roadmap for reunification. Today, as our nation becomes increasingly fragmented along political issues and divergent views of our fundamental values and principles of freedom, engaging people based on this former slave's unassailable historical contribution offers the most effective messaging for winning new hearts and minds.
**A Symbol of Republican Values:** Just as Lincoln turned to Douglass for guiding the salvation of America, Republicans can leverage Douglass as a pivotal symbol for fully realizing the greatness of our country. In a historical context, emulating Lincoln and using the impactful legacy of Frederick Douglass serves to open the door to all voters to find common ground and reunite our country.
**Frederick Douglass played a crucial role in the birth of the Republican Party:** The Republican Party was founded in 1854 by abolitionists who aimed to end slavery and advocate for the civil rights of Black people, with Frederick Douglass playing a significant role in initiating the political campaign.

Today, as our nation becomes increasingly fragmented along political issues and divergent views of our fundamental values and principles of freedom, engaging people based on this former slave's unassailable historical contribution offers the most effective messaging for winning new hearts and minds. A Symbol of Republican Values: Just as Lincoln turned to Douglass for guiding the salvation of America, Republicans can leverage Douglass as a pivotal symbol for fully realizing the greatness of our country. In a historical context, emulating Lincoln and using the impactful legacy of Frederick Douglass serves to open the door to all voters to find common ground and reunite our country. # **CD 8 Mayors Endorse Gabe Evans for Congress**
_Evans Wins Overwhelming Support of District’s Mayors __Against Incumbent Democrat_ (FORT LUPTON, CO) – Republican Congressional District 8 candidate Gabe Evans today announced the endorsement of 11 mayors across Congressional District 8. The state representative, combat veteran, and former police officer has gained the endorsements of half the district’s mayors. “Mayors across our district want to fight back against Washington’s punitive regulations, open border policies, and ‘defund the police’ policies,” stated Evans. “Our mayors will be valued partners in our movement to improve the quality of life for our communities by promoting good jobs, restoring law and order, getting fentanyl off our streets, lowering the cost of living, and reining in punitive regulations and runaway spending.” “I’m pleased to endorse Gabe Evans for Congress,” stated Thornton Mayor Jan Kulmann. “Gabe has been a champion for Adams and Weld counties in the Legislature, and I know he’ll do the same in Congress. We need strong, can-do, effective representation to fix the big problems facing our nation and state, and that’s Gabe Evans. He’s been running toward challenge his entire adult life, as a combat vet, former police officer, and a conservative state representative in a liberal dominated Legislature.” “Gabe Evans gets results for conservatives because unlike many politicians he’s not afraid of challenge,” observed La Salle Mayor Andrew Martinez. “He runs toward it. I trust Gabe on the issues and challenges that are priorities for Adams, Weld, and Larimer families – closing the border, looking out for our jobs and values, bringing down the cost of living, and restoring law and order. Gabe Evans has my strong endorsement for Congress.” The following CD 8 Mayors have endorsed Gabe Evans for Congress: Brighton Mayor Greg Mills Dacono Mayor Adam Morehead Federal Heights Mayor Linda Montoya Fort Lupton Mayor Zo Stieber Gilcrest Mayor Steve Nothem Greeley Mayor John Gates Kersey Mayor Gary Lagrimanta La Salle Mayor Andy Martinez Platteville Mayor Mike Cowper Thornton Mayor Jan Kulmann Westminster Mayor Nancy McNally Learn more about Gabe Evans’ campaign at [www.ElectGabeEvans.com](https://wayrap.clicks.mlsend.com/td/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjYwMjExMCxcImxcIjoxMjM4NjE0MzE3MjQ1NDEzOTYsXCJyXCI6MTIzODYxNDMzNDA3NTA1OTE0fSIsInMiOiIzODdhNGJjYmIxNzIzMzhiIn0). \- 30 -

We need strong, can-do, effective representation to fix the big problems facing our nation and state, and that’s Gabe Evans. He’s been running toward challenge his entire adult life, as a combat vet, former police officer, and a conservative state representative in a liberal dominated Legislature.” “Gabe Evans gets results for conservatives because unlike many politicians he’s not afraid of challenge,” observed La Salle Mayor Andrew Martinez. “He runs toward it. I trust Gabe on the issues and challenges that are priorities for Adams, Weld, and Larimer families – closing the border, looking out for our jobs and values, bringing down the cost of living, and restoring law and order. Gabe Evans has my strong endorsement for Congress.” The following CD 8 Mayors have endorsed Gabe Evans for Congress: Brighton Mayor Greg Mills Dacono Mayor Adam Morehead Federal Heights Mayor Linda Montoya Fort Lupton Mayor Zo Stieber Gilcrest Mayor Steve Nothem Greeley Mayor John Gates Kersey Mayor Gary Lagrimanta La Salle Mayor Andy Martinez Platteville Mayor Mike Cowper Thornton Mayor Jan Kulmann Westminster Mayor Nancy McNally Learn more about Gabe Evans’ campaign at . \- 30 - | | | | Elect Gabe Evans P.O. Hello,
The day before the anniversary of the Supreme Court’s disastrous _Dobbs_ decision, I woke up to Fox News and Lauren Boebert attacking my sister and my 81-year-old father.
For decades, Dad was an OB-GYN. He delivered thousands of babies and wrote books on how to get pregnant and to navigate menopause. Dad provided women with full access to all kinds of reproductive health care, including abortions, in the years right after _Roe_ – and he has now had to watch as women’s reproductive rights are gutted in the aftermath of _Dobbs_.
Dad and his clinic faced many threats over the years. It’s no exaggeration to say that he put his own safety – and that of his family – at risk in order to protect the rights of women to make their own medical decisions.
But I’m not sure he ever expected to see a sitting member of Congress attacking him – or my sister who followed in his footsteps – in a national news outlet. **It’s disgusting. These kinds of personal attacks against my family have no place in our politics and do nothing to serve the people of Western and Southern Colorado.**
If extremists like Lauren Boebert and my new Republican opponents want to have a conversation about reproductive rights in this country, I am more than happy to have that debate. We can talk about how I support _freedom_ and _liberty_ – and how they support big government intruding into the lives of women. We can talk about how they support a national ban on abortion – with no exceptions for rape, incest, or the life of the mother. And we can talk about how they are so extreme, they even want to ban the pill that’s been used by women for decades.
I am willing to talk all day about the fringe view that the government should be dictating women’s medical decisions. **But what I won’t accept is extremists like Lauren Boebert and Fox News attacking my father and my sister.**
I am _incredibly_ proud of my father. He provided health care to women when they needed it during some of the happiest – and most devastating – moments of their lives. Before retirement, he would drive two hours to Planned Parenthood and help teach the next generation of health care providers, like my sister. And no one – not Fox News, and especially not extremists like Lauren Boebert or my new Republican opponents – is going to stop my family from continuing to stand up for a woman’s right to choose.
**We already scared off Lauren Boebert. In 2022, I came just 546 votes shy of defeating her and winning this House seat. I’m ready to finish the job and replace Boebert in Congress in November, but these are the kinds of ugly attacks that I’m already up against.**
[**Please, if you can afford to, will you give $5 or more right now to my campaign to help me win this critical House seat and replace Lauren Boebert in Congress? Our race was the closest in the entire country in 2022. But I’m not taking money from corporate PACs, so I’m counting on grassroots donors like you if I’m going to win.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86696410/478711993/1610638071?refcode=em20240611am-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=65eb4eff-1028-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NWViNGVmZi0xMDI4LWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8-iW0zAC75RHO7xmULakZ90hZVPwliyw0zuAqe7yUHk=)

clean_body: The day before the anniversary of the Supreme Court’s disastrous Dobbs decision, I woke up to Fox News and Lauren Boebert attacking my sister and my 81-year-old father. Hello, The day before the anniversary of the Supreme Court’s disastrous Dobbs decision, I woke up to Fox News and Lauren Boebert attacking my sister and my 81-year-old father. For decades, Dad was an OB-GYN. He delivered thousands of babies and wrote books on how to get pregnant and to navigate menopause. Dad provided women with full access to all kinds of reproductive health care, including abortions, in the years right after Roe – and he has now had to watch as women’s reproductive rights are gutted in the aftermath of Dobbs. Dad and his clinic faced many threats over the years. It’s no exaggeration to say that he put his own safety – and that of his family – at risk in order to protect the rights of women to make their own medical decisions. But I’m not sure he ever expected to see a sitting member of Congress attacking him – or my sister who followed in his footsteps – in a national news outlet. It’s disgusting. These kinds of personal attacks against my family have no place in our politics and do nothing to serve the people of Western and Southern Colorado. If extremists like Lauren Boebert and my new Republican opponents want to have a conversation about reproductive rights in this country, I am more than happy to have that debate. We can talk about how I support freedom and liberty – and how they support big government intruding into the lives of women. We can talk about how they support a national ban on abortion – with no exceptions for rape, incest, or the life of the mother. And we can talk about how they are so extreme, they even want to ban the pill that’s been used by women for decades. I am willing to talk all day about the fringe view that the government should be dictating women’s medical decisions. But what I won’t accept is extremists like Lauren Boebert and Fox News attacking my father and my sister. I am incredibly proud of my father. He provided health care to women when they needed it during some of the happiest – and most devastating – moments of their lives. Before retirement, he would drive two hours to Planned Parenthood and help teach the next generation of health care providers, like my sister. And no one – not Fox News, and especially not extremists like Lauren Boebert or my new Republican opponents – is going to stop my family from continuing to stand up for a woman’s right to choose. We already scared off Lauren Boebert. In 2022, I came just 546 votes shy of defeating her and winning this House seat. I’m ready to finish the job and replace Boebert in Congress in November, but these are the kinds of ugly attacks that I’m already up against. = Please use the links in this email to start a monthly donation through ActBlue: | | = | = | | = | = | | = | = I knew this campaign was going to get nasty, but I never expected it this early – or for the other side to go after my family. name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: Happy Immigrant Heritage Month!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
I want to encourage us all to come together to uplift the lived experiences, practices, and innovations that immigrants have made to our communities.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20240611-3974-footer&t=1&akid=3974%2E420207%2EUBpJ3v)
Peter, Happy Immigrant Heritage Month!
This month, and every month, I am grateful to celebrate the lived experiences, practices, and innovations that immigrants have made to our communities.
I came to the United States at 16 years old because my parents thought this country is where I could succeed, they believed in the American Dream. And every day, I am reminded of the resilience, courage, and contributions that immigrants bring to this country.
As an immigrant, and someone who has spent decades organizing for immigrants’ rights, I know that now more than ever, **the American people want — and deserve — an immigration system that champions real solutions over harsh enforcement.**
**In Congress, I will continue to advocate for real solutions that allow all of us to thrive, not just survive.**[**If you stand with me and this collective work, please contribute $3 to strengthen our movement.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-email-20240611.ib4F_L&refcode=em20240611-3974&t=2&akid=3974%2E420207%2EUBpJ3v)

I am forever grateful for the support and faith you have in our movement, Peter. Thank you.
In solidarity,
Pramila Jayapal

Today is the day!

Election Day is here, and the polls are open until 7:00 PM this evening. I’m reaching out to you with an urgent message: Please make sure to get out and vote for my husband, Rick Becker, in the next few hours!

Rick is a man of unparalleled character – he is honest, trustworthy, and deeply committed to doing what’s right for North Dakota and our country. His determination is unmatched; when he believes in something, he never gives up the fight.

He will work tirelessly to secure our southern border and protect American families because he understands the importance of keeping our nation safe and prosperous.

Rick will be a strong ally to President Donald Trump, working together to advance the America-First agenda. With Rick in the House, we can be confident that our interests will be well-represented and our voices will be heard.

Remember, North Dakota only has one representative in the House, and we cannot afford to elect the wrong person. We need someone who will stand up for our values and fight for our future.

That someone is Rick Becker.

So, let's get out there and vote for Rick today! Together, we can make a difference and ensure that North Dakota has a trusted voice in Washington.

Sincerely,

I want to take a moment to remind you of my journey to the U.S. Senate, the important le ssons I have learned along the way, and why I continue to believe wholeheartedly in our beloved state.

My father, a World War II veteran, left school during the Great Depression to join the Army. Though he only had a ninth grade education, he built a career as a hard-working cement finisher. My mother, a dedicated voter who never missed an election, instilled in me the importance of civic duty.

>From my parents, I inherited an unwavering love for this country that I have proudly carried throughout my life. It's something I strive to keep alive in Wyoming.

Later, in medical school, I learned the importance of having a plan before taking action, a lesson that has proven invaluable in both my medical career and my service as your senator. Just as in surgery, effective leadership requires a clear vision and a strategic approach to problem-solving.

Already, your support has been instrumental in my journey, and I promise to continue fighting for the issues that matter most to Wyoming families.

Sincerely,
Senator John Barrasso [CHIP IN FOR A STRONG WYOMING](http://links.primaryupdate.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=ce262f5752784ef4ba6f0ff9ff155f14&_e=-Bkm34lVhx-RZ5b_6UvIfGN6d0o0W6lc5M0Kq2EQwNwYahwqCcddoHQ_vR16kMjUE3TZKzjSZVHNwr54I80WQ6n1ja32HFfK1tLU5gXqNzBwQ4N-rMt771Mg6HhAacknhZoUPisiQaX8RvESBDhdzXiPFv8bA9XTTv6pEkyiXXtltu6SyidC6N4etOOAG6nIIcewUjFBMvaludfwppZDQi_ocqkH2Ga5BnWA_66Hpx_cr7b0uQNHIF0O_H8TOFMXTN_52D_NTPcGC9q9P9j3thNW5n1jsfrhxJbdoBFawqE%3D)

[](https://click.act.democrats.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqvpOShxPWr9mFhJMw1S-wTtvhltHWfNwNtDIaYBJbNv2OiYGsvOb7Ojyb0iUS8Qi3RrJqnKcLfj4R0qPHHJ1iJZAjvDwxHL3IoeF6FZwQBaXB7v_smEp7TT7DRPuUCS-tmhL9aIQucVaSyL3GbI-LwBDm6KkxNZWxh4-dcJdpdSZXKhfbv8EBOejpslk3R-RV9YeLv925NE4Mu0uZtjZ87HWxLrH4CgvOqyBI1g_0U_1wsX_JJKOk183f4ymcfln63RAjKUMVhgvAvcUyZ-k0_VtVyF3lqdrhT1i_B1jT9RYXULHVnm2mBR136ixFwwuuoKjKdy-pS_dk6Ap4x9NIg8dpQk0cqVBFlHGpuegDjF0-XIQonAyJKHHq5xbTKqFkuL-jtHNuI1_Ibx1yUZQUtsP8HQTDYnWsZQd10piAsmEAP6JK4VRVvJMWi-eXFUT-jvzFJEP1bmM0wcAQ99qMAj/474/El-6iZ3fRMuWbcdP2Gvp6g/h0/h001.UeA8X_YwEjBwvY3QuIZDwWrNp0TlAYjmDAtPuDNS3D8) Derek -- Twelve years ago, while running to serve in the House of Representatives (before the Senate even) I had the honor of speaking at the Democratic National Convention. I told the story of how I was co-piloting my Blackhawk north of Baghdad when a rocket-propelled grenade hit our helicopter, exploding in my lap, ripping off one leg, crushing the other and tearing my right arm apart. I shared how my survival and the survival of my entire crew depended on all of us pulling together. And even though they were wounded themselves and insurgents were nearby, they refused to leave a fallen comrade -- me -- behind. And I talked about how that election -- like this one -- is about the issues that matter to us: building an economy that will create jobs here at home and out-compete countries around the world. But it’s also about something else. It’s about whether we will do for our fellow Americans what my crew did for me; whether we’ll look out for the hardest hit and the disabled; whether we’ll pull together in a time of need; whether we’ll refuse to give up until the job is done. In this election, we are up against Donald Trump and a very inspired MAGA-right. And it will take all of us doing our part if we are going to reelect Joe Biden and Democrats up and down the ballot. There is no organization better positioned to make that happen than the Democratic National Committee. But they can't do it alone, so I am asking: [**Can I count on you to make an $7 contribution directly to the Democratic National Committee? They will put your support right to work electing Democrats everywhere this November.** ](https://click.act.democrats.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqvpOShxPWr9mFhJMw1S-wTtvhltHWfNwNtDIaYBJbNv2OiYGsvOb7Ojyb0iUS8Qi3RrJqnKcLfj4R0qPHHJ1iJZAjvDwxHL3IoeF6FZwQBaXB7v_smEp7TT7DRPuUCS-tnfE9FgpBBPWPouueK259JspRXo4qeEt4kgx-6vuUPSuLaA4ERbVXoo6__1RcbBCh4SQeFpwcl5TqBEhXpwBruIBUVB5akbhriyCtGNBfGnMMoJp6I_A-BBdSttNgjTR6IsV7NQuN8-Vd8nN0PYjPzGcaM8NGyjPK7kiNXm5vSBv16RlbNjagBozUYyVLRiw9t7GH--QONVrV1BNvojN5BA5TqJvH_lXw6bdEI2zkZQexIdwgCJbEQR3T5t2wuqofhPDYlZrNlH8WFqdhDrsI4j8pt6F6bh9LXjlsv3GUoZJDMLr0vATCvtPIzF-MD3Snn-gysVqXr9hoTXdf3va3T0/474/El-6iZ3fRMuWbcdP2Gvp6g/h1/h001.M--_r9vEaInkJ1jnaEAgR029meNy_BxuvpO76A3XsH0)

clean_body: | | Derek -- Twelve years ago, while running to serve in the House of Representatives (before the Senate even) I had the honor of speaking at the Democratic National Convention. I told the story of how I was co-piloting my Blackhawk north of Baghdad when a rocket-propelled grenade hit our helicopter, exploding in my lap, ripping off one leg, crushing the other and tearing my right arm apart. I shared how my survival and the survival of my entire crew depended on all of us pulling together. And even though they were wounded themselves and insurgents were nearby, they refused to leave a fallen comrade -- me -- behind. And I talked about how that election -- like this one -- is about the issues that matter to us: building an economy that will create jobs here at home and out-compete countries around the world. But it’s also about something else. It’s about whether we will do for our fellow Americans what my crew did for me; whether we’ll look out for the hardest hit and the disabled; whether we’ll pull together in a time of need; whether we’ll refuse to give up until the job is done. In this election, we are up against Donald Trump and a very inspired MAGA-right. And it will take all of us doing our part if we are going to reelect Joe Biden and Democrats up and down the ballot. name: State Representative Ryan Chamberlin
subject: Weekly Update from Rep. Ryan Chamberlin
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/repryanchamberlin/official-newsletter-12697400?e=d1c1b9864f)
---
| |
---
| | **WEEKLY UPDATE FROM REP. RYAN CHAMBERLIN**
---
| My Fellow Floridians,

My office and I had another busy week out in the district, meeting with constituents and attending important community events. I greatly appreciate you taking the time to keep up with me and my work for **Florida**. During this year’s legislative session, it was an honor to be the voice of **House District 24** in**Tallahassee**. My fellow legislators and I accomplished so much good work for our state, and we are just getting started. The **Sunshine State** is already leading the nation in education and economic growth, and I know we will continue to set the gold standard on other issues important to Floridians in the years to come.

If there is something I can do for you, please do not hesitate to contact my office. I want to work with you to build a brighter future for Florida and our district. **You can get in touch with my office by[clicking here](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=95c01bf633&e=d1c1b9864f). **We would be more than happy to assist you in any way we can!
---
| | **Wednesday, June 5 - Tour of Ma Barker House & Grand Opening of Imagine North Magnolia Park**
---
|
---
---
|
---
---
| My wife, Jenny, and I, alongside other **Marion County** elected officials joined **The Honorable** **George Albright** for a tour of the **Ma Barker House** in **Carney Island, Ocklawaha**. It was incredible to see that everything is still just as it was in 1935. The house is a piece of Marion County history worth learning about and exploring.
---
|
---
|
---
---
| Later that day, my staff had the opportunity to attend the grand opening ceremony for the **Imagine North Magnolia Park** at **Marion Heights**. The project was funded by the **North Magnolia Community Redevelopment Agency** and the **Ocala Recreation & Parks Department**. This funding helped bring the community to life, and it was exciting to have many kids enjoying the new park on the very first day.
---
| | **Tuesday, June 4 - Campaign Event for Conservative Candidate Greg Folley**
---
|
---
|
---
---
| It was great to spend some time in **Naples** for a campaign event with **Representative Bob Rommel** for conservative candidate **Greg Folley for State House District 81**. I look forward to supporting strong, business-minded candidates in this upcoming election!
---
| | **Monday, June 3 - FHA “State of the Hospitals” Roundtable**
---
|
---
---
| I had the pleasure of attending the **Florida Hospital Association “State of the Hospitals” Roundtable** in **Orlando**. We had the opportunity to discuss the association’s efforts to continue educating and bringing awareness to the top issues hospitals currently face. It was great to talk about how we will work together to tackle these issues in**Tallahassee** during the next legislative session.
---
| | **Weekend, June 1 & 2 - Association of Network Marketing Professionals**
---
|
---
---
| It was great to speak to the **Association of Network Marketing Professionals** (ANMP) last weekend. I had the honor of addressing hundreds of entrepreneurs on the topic of free enterprise and the **Free State of Florida**. Thank you to **ANMP** for the invitation! The United States was founded on entrepreneurial principles, and we simply can’t let elected officials who have had no experience in business dictate how entrepreneurs should run theirs.
---
| | **Legislation Signed into Law by Governor Ron DeSantis**
---
| Last week, **Governor Ron DeSantis** signed legislation into law that will protect children and families from harm during custody exchanges. Thank you to the bill sponsors and our great governor for always putting the safety of Floridians first.

_**Signed:**_ [CS/CS/HB 385 – Safe Exchange of Minor Children](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=357d777a4a&e=d1c1b9864f)
---
|
---
| | Thank you for electing me to serve you in the **Florida House**! Since taking office, I have worked hard to make our state and district even better. I’m only getting started in my work to preserve our traditional values and advance the conservative movement.

Have a wonderful week! I look forward to sharing with you again very soon.

Best regards,

**Ryan Chamberlin**
******State Representative**
**District 24**
---
| | _Copyright © 2024 State Representative Ryan Chamberlin, All rights reserved._
State Representative Ryan Chamberlin

**Our mailing address is:**
1101 The Capitol
402 South Monroe Street
Tallahassee, FL 32399-1300

You can [update your preferences](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/profile?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=929c76fdea&e=d1c1b9864f&c=be571ed9c7) or [unsubscribe from this list](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/unsubscribe?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=929c76fdea&t=b&e=d1c1b9864f&c=be571ed9c7).

Friends,
Believe it or not, Louisiana spent the last eight years suffering under a Democrat governor. He claimed to be moderate, but would block conservative reforms at every turn.
That changed last October when Louisiana elected a conservative governor in Jeff Landry, who received over 50% of the vote to avoid a runoff in the state's jungle primary system.
But not only was Landry elected, the Louisiana Freedom Caucus, which we helped launch last year, doubled its size from 9 members to over 20 members.
Well, the first legislative session with new conservative leadership in Louisiana just wrapped up.
In addition to cutting the budget - IN REAL TERMS - by $3 billion and passing universal school choice, here's a list of every Louisiana Freedom Caucus-led bill heading to Gov. Landry's desk:
* **HB745 Universal school choice**
* **SB1 Constitutional Carry**
* **SB388 Allows state police to arrest and deport illegal aliens**
* **HB357 Ban Central Bank Digital Currencies (CBDCs)**
* **HB47 Ban COVID vaccine mandates**
* **HB121 Require teachers to use pronouns according to sex on birth certificate for students**
* **HB873 Closed primary elections for members of Congress**
* **SB262 Ban teaching of DEI in schools**
* **HB122 Ban teaching of sexual orientation and gender identity in public schools**
* **SB208 Ban sanctuary cities**
* **SB101 Ban rank choice voting**
* **SB194 Bans local governments from passing firearm restrictions greater than state law**
* **HB373 Fines protesters who picket outside personal residences**
* **SB234 Prohibit companies from discriminating against firearm industry**
* **SB195 Work requirements for SNAP**
* **Constitutional amendment to ban Zuckerbucks**
* **HB976 Mandate visitation at healthcare facilities**
* **HB608 "What is a Woman" bill codifying the definition of men and women in state law**
* **SB 420 Creates a crime of election fraud or forgery**
* **SB 294 Bans college campus groups funded by terrorist organizations**
* **HB383 Limits liability for people in fear of their life while rioters are illegally blocking a road**
* **HB47 Mandates notification of vaccine exemptions in schools**
* **HB205 Expands RICO and racketeering crimes for organized riots**

Friend, the famous saying dime con quién andas, y te diré quién eres – tell me who you walk with, and I’ll tell you who you are – resonates deeply during election season.
Who a candidate associates with is a clear indication of how they will lead our district if elected.

name: Ruben Gallego for Arizona
subject: What Trump needs most
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
If Trump gets the Senate he can confirm hundreds more judges and reshape the judiciary for generations to come. He can pass tax cuts for the most wealthy and leave the rest of us with the bill. He can bulldoze the opposition, purge dissent, and pass his entire radical agenda.
#

Peter —
What Trump needs most isn’t actually the White House.
It’s not millions of MAGA supporters.
It’s not a ton of CEOs he can make backroom deals with in exchange for massive donations.
He needs all that, sure. But what he needs most is the U.S. Senate.
If Trump gets the Senate he can confirm hundreds more judges and reshape the judiciary for generations to come. He can pass tax cuts for billionaires and leave the rest of us with the bill. He can bulldoze the opposition, purge dissent, and pass his entire radical agenda.
What Trump needs most is the Senate, and Kari Lake must win in Arizona if he’s going to get it.
That’s why wealthy donors are pouring into Kari Lake’s campaign right now, running millions in attack ads against Ruben. That’s why Trump’s first stop after his guilty verdict was Arizona, where he attacked our campaign directly. And that’s why we are writing to you right now.
They’re going to do whatever they have to if it means defeating Ruben. We have to do whatever we can to stop them.
[**Please, if you’re with us and if you want to defeat Trump and Kari Lake as badly as we do, make a donation to Ruben Gallego’s campaign. We wish the stakes weren’t this high, but they are. Friends-
We’ve been hard at work over the last few weeks and today is finally the day. The 2024 Freedom Virginia Affordability Scorecard is now live!
View our 2024 Affordability Scorecard here! [https://freedomva.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/2024-Freedom-Virginia-Affordability-Scorecard.pdf]
We’ve named 12 Affordability Champions and 32 Economic Security Allies from the General Assembly for their work in making Virginia more affordable. We have also highlighted over 20 pieces of legislation aimed at lowering everyday costs for Virginians. Our scorecard outlines where lawmakers stood on bills that would have made Virginians’ lives easier.
These included initiatives to create a Prescription Drug Affordability Board, establish a Paid Family and Medical Leave program, and ban the predatory practice of adding surprise junk fees to the end of a transaction. While none of these bills became law this year, each gained momentum as they advanced farther than ever before, with two of the three garnering bipartisan support.
While we have many hurdles still to overcome, the 2024 General Assembly session marked some critical strides forward toward making our economy more fair and more affordable.
We are grateful for all of the support we received this year and we look forward to continuing the fight in 2025!
Thank you
Rhena Hicks

Hi Peter, can I share something with you?
When I came out in college, I knew I was interested in a career in public service. But I feared that I would have to face a serious choice between pursuing the field of my dreams or living my authentic life openly.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86702542/478735115/1075770292?source=LOC_EM_FR_2024.06.11_B1_BaldwinPrideSplit_Actives&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODQ4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMjgzOTA0My0xZDI4LWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=83GVw2A7YLv0-5XtQYvQM2hZCzo-ysQ0pJkt9o9rdlY=)
After seeing others in the LGBTQ+ community demonstrate acts of courage by coming out, being themselves, and being public about who they are and who they love, I came to realize that I could do both:
**I could run for office and be honest about who I am — so that’s exactly what I did.**
When I became the first openly gay Senator elected in our nation's history, I understood that I needed to use this extraordinary opportunity to make a difference in people's lives. From lowering prescription drug prices to protecting same-sex marriage through the _Respect for Marriage Act,_ I’ve worked hard every day since to do just that.
That's why I ran for office in the first place — not to make history, but to make a difference. And folks like you supported me because you wanted to make a difference, too.

But I feared that I would have to face a serious choice between pursuing the field of my dreams or living my authentic life openly. = After seeing others in the LGBTQ+ community demonstrate acts of courage by coming out, being themselves, and being public about who they are and who they love, I came to realize that I could do both: I could run for office and be honest about who I am — so that’s exactly what I did. When I became the first openly gay Senator elected in our nation's history, I understood that I needed to use this extraordinary opportunity to make a difference in people's lives. From lowering prescription drug prices to protecting same-sex marriage through the Respect for Marriage Act, I’ve worked hard every day since to do just that. That's why I ran for office in the first place — not to make history, but to make a difference. And folks like you supported me because you wanted to make a difference, too. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately and be split between Dick Durbin and Tammy Baldwin: ****=** **=** **=** **=** **=** **=** We have made incredible progress over the years in the fight for equality — but Peter, we cannot mistake that progress for a total victory. Republican-led state legislatures across the country continue to pass harmful legislation, especially targeting the transgender community and LGBTQ+ youth. In 2024 alone, 515 anti-LGBTQ+ bills have been introduced across the country. It's going to take all of us to counter these right wing attacks so everyone grows up knowing they belong, and that kindness and inclusion — not hatred and division — are American values. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately and be split between Dick Durbin and Tammy Baldwin: **=** **=** **=** **=** **=** **=** Thank you for your ongoing support. Today [Newsweek](https://substack.com/redirect/b83164ae-7d0f-4434-b983-a47a8a473f10?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) reported my comments on the Supreme Court where I said:
> "Alito caught on tape admitting he will not be impartial. When are the hearings @SenatorDurbin?" **human rights lawyer Qasim Rashid[wrote](https://substack.com/redirect/23a22548-fc14-42d8-9264-7f584c5901cf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**. "A reminder once more SCOTUS has (almost) never upheld justice in America, but largely been the obstacle to justice. The receipts back it up throughout history."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8480db76-55db-4429-9caf-5e5f6ee14635?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Credit: Alito: AP Photo/Susan Walsh. Thomas: AP Photo/J. Scott Applewhite
I'll start with a blunt statement. If the Supreme Court has any hope left to maintain any legitimacy, Justice Alito and Justice Thomas should face immediate impeachment and removal. I've written before on the dire need to [expand the Supreme Court](https://substack.com/redirect/6391d1b5-caa4-4fb0-ae53-d09a9e76ef47?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to protect our democracy, as well as the horrifying receipts that the [Supreme Court has been arguably the greatest blockade](https://substack.com/redirect/053cf710-86cd-473c-8976-805b5ea95663?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to civil rights and justice in America. Now, the antics from Justice Alito and Justice Thomas further prove that my criticisms of the Supreme Court aren't just historical critiques--they're contemporary facts.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..NhNRSeFqTAIGUhLTY_3C5ByGJ84nsR0CWwN_0hCXVzo?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=145542268)
Let's start with Justice Alito, or rather, his wife, Martha-Ann Alito, who said:
> I'm German. I'm from Germany. My heritage is German. You come after me, I'm gonna give it back to you.
These, and other even more concerning comments from leaked audio by journalist and documentary filmmaker [Lauren Windsor](https://substack.com/redirect/f72bc3ee-952c-421f-950f-9b36a62d5c32?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), should be a wake up call to anyone who cares about our basic civil rights. Mrs. Alito went on to demonize LGBTQ Americans and make clear she wants a Constitution based not on secular principles, but Biblical mandate. Can we agree it is less than ideal, to put it lightly, that the wife of a Supreme Court justice does not seem to believe in separation of religion and state?
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/acceaa66-5a1a-4bb8-b68c-d446b62314ed?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Credit: Pablo Martinez Monsivais/Associated Press
Also, let's be clear. If I was the spouse of a powerful politician who had the ability to undermine the entire Constitution and rights for hundreds of millions of people, and I said, "_I'm Pakistani. I'm from Pakistan. My heritage is Pakistani..._ " I'd be told immediately by MAGAs to "_go back where you came from_." But a white German-American woman says it and, well, that's just her opinion? This is even more urgent given how, per Justice Alito, Martha Alito has repeatedly flown pro-insurrection flags at their home--while her husband is about to hear a case about the insurrection and the limits of Presidential immunity.
Justice Alito insisted her opinions were her own, and not opinions he shares. That mask has come off as we now hear the grotesque comments made by Justice Alito regarding his lack of impartiality on deciding cases. He [said](https://substack.com/redirect/2c4b0f34-c98d-49c4-927b-3e7b09b3d1c9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> One side or the other is going to win. I mean, there can be a way of working -- a way of living together peacefully, but it's difficult, you know, because there are differences on fundamental things that really can't be compromised. It's not like you can split the difference.
No regard for objectivity or impartiality. A flat out statement that one side, "his" side, is going to win and he's not willing to compromise. This is an exact contradiction of the Supreme Court oath which requires Justices to affirm, "...I will faithfully and impartially discharge and perform all the duties incumbent upon me..."
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..NhNRSeFqTAIGUhLTY_3C5ByGJ84nsR0CWwN_0hCXVzo?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=145542268)
Considering Alito's disdain for Supreme Court precedent given his overturn of Roe, his disregard for the US Constitution given his pro insurrection flags, and his disregard for confidentiality given his diatribe admitting lack of impartiality--why is he still on the bench? (And also, is there any doubt left that he leaked Dobbs decision on purpose?)
Not to be outdone in corruption is Justice Thomas, who just happens to be fond of conservative right wing billionaires.
I recall when applying for my law license, I was required to disclose toll violations and parking tickets from a decade prior that were less than $100. How absurd, therefore, that as a sitting SCOTUS justice, Clarence Thomas has accepted at least $4M in gifts (bribes?) that we now know of, and did not disclose them or recuse himself from cases involving his benefactors? How can SCOTUS be deemed legitimate when one of its members is so clearly bought and paid for? | | Dear Friend,

C.S. Lewis and J.R.R. Tolkien wrote some of the twentieth century's most beloved works of literature, including robust defenses of the Christian faith.

Today, I want to share an exclusive and free video series with you that considers Lewis and Tolkien in the context of their membership in the Inklings--an informal professor-student literary group at Oxford in the 1930s and 40s.
[](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=e5537b08ecd148439b4a7ce84d5073b5&_e=TcbEtz4uf_XvplxjIJf0AFMXJONHaoEI9uKrLHIs2iG1-3mtkxxYkMEXbCCGVGPVV-oIlZnMbWXJCpT2w4P__X8hXGvpk2_Mz-qSsQd_3gqsC4XUNYIyDBQJmdZpsmxMyRrxYne1crFtQAdvovMAExQFYX5ZrIPxSiOmgkq-KSq4YPOBNA5TwI8bbJvr-UYcext-tWXZiO-jWqZ6EF51Vksm3tpvXlICtgPqF6ePGttylpyBRHYswiQ-LiBz_3hh9Ta_p9o4QXvM_87yRzTmU0EuvNtrWufGkTy5tN6PA3vEiGUoLsFkj06Ci5Ll4g6uRrXYUiXmtjRmj3cg1VBpovMcCVSI7YzzR4g86C4KJglJCMyD1wgxd4_ZYJIcvkxx)
**You can receive instant access to this free video series about the Inklings by using this secure link now:**

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/the-inklings-cca/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=e5537b08ecd148439b4a7ce84d5073b5&_e=TcbEtz4uf_XvplxjIJf0AFMXJONHaoEI9uKrLHIs2iG1-3mtkxxYkMEXbCCGVGPVV-oIlZnMbWXJCpT2w4P__X8hXGvpk2_Mz-qSsQd_3gqsC4XUNYIyDBQJmdZpsmxMyRrxYne1crFtQAdvovMAExQFYX5ZrIPxSiOmgkq-KSq4YPOBNA5TwI8bbJvr-UYcext-tWXZiO-jWqZ6EF51Vksm3tpvXlICtgPqF6ePGtsy_ZroZz80Q-uu7csNBAZ5GWBZ3-TB1Sh9IGw8wg_dMf7h_FB-VaB3FN-221BfOO4y8xQBIHApbWBOS0YOYz-KI5driGu1Hy31OK-6mpWB1dFqd-mzE-2lR8krx3xs65O2qYPYuGzexNv3jRTd7YRG)**

C.S. Lewis is best known for his Narnia books--such as _The Lion, the Witch, and the Wardrobe_ --and his apologetics, including _Mere Christianity_. Indeed, Lewis is one of the greatest Christian apologists of all time.

J.R.R. Tolkien's most renowned works are _The Hobbit_ and _The Lord of the Rings _trilogy.

That both were men of genius is indisputable. Both men also devoted countless hours to honing their craft. This included subjecting their writing to the scrutiny of their fellow Inklings, who met regularly for conversation and to read aloud from and discuss their current work.

**The Inklings are a fascinating topic of study, which is why we 've created a free online video series for you to enjoy. **

The video series, titled "The Inklings," was filmed on the Hillsdale College campus. It examines the ideas that bound the Inklings, what they accomplished, and the continuing importance of their works today--with a special focus on Lewis and Tolkien.

**You can use the secure link below to receive instant access to "The Inklings" free video series:**

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/the-inklings-cca/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=e5537b08ecd148439b4a7ce84d5073b5&_e=TcbEtz4uf_XvplxjIJf0AFMXJONHaoEI9uKrLHIs2iG1-3mtkxxYkMEXbCCGVGPVV-oIlZnMbWXJCpT2w4P__X8hXGvpk2_Mz-qSsQd_3gqsC4XUNYIyDBQJmdZpsmxMyRrxYne1crFtQAdvovMAExQFYX5ZrIPxSiOmgkq-KSq4YPOBNA5TwI8bbJvr-UYcext-tWXZiO-jWqZ6EF51Vksm3tpvXlICtgPqF6ePGttxOHcFpOo411xm1RnlAnlRqmvoLv_IWZYB52F_X58qFhs-HUI7SjRzpYhqQ1qKyw0U-bj3L-4Aig6AU07GGP1beXxM5UrwwOcriW8w4XylCkS4f8nqXq4MEOi-zM--KcBC86jWPHvACtBoSsTgmL5n)**

Lewis and Tolkien thought the Inklings' meetings contributed significantly to their literary success. As models of civil discussion and intelligent debate, they stand in stark contrast to today's "cancel culture."

The Inklings, are therefore, worth studying not only for their great literary achievements but also because they exemplify the free speech that is essential to the pursuit of truth.

That's why Hillsdale College created a free online video series on the Inklings. I hope you'll use the secure link above and start watching it today.

| From the Desk of Dr. Ben Carson: Dear Fellow Patriot,

We are witnessing a brutal, unceasing, and deadly assault currently being waged against American families--especially the traditional nuclear family. I'm sure you've felt it.

That's why I launched the American Cornerstone Institute--what I call a "think tank / do tank" -- in order to continue this perilous fight to protect, shore up, and support American families. [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=4ff8c6f28cde4a27919181598d9bee7d&_e=9GamrgAanoviix8T2zXvCmNWd1sL7NnCGVAJW7-2CB9kricDt-rp0Zi-AfRgoNjUkxAxSjxFlZAtY9fbqa9kpNH8-JNmC4Hkbk97rA2NtF6VRXoJpwLgBzDBkd7VWaqxSbrFeve8wp8DuHOhKMlAlB8NEbL6w87sBB9eiRA_Q1X4uWtcUPnUQTdYfLzvvGxSaVTGc9wSDRFpoWhqNhhWr2jiansvCIPAFyJt5d-ZepK2kKHA64m0RXWNFPBQyR8ekLxPKbw1WR_-8ubU2kvBR6Ql1PTi1oQXhvx0QjL6m7chI5fKFojeTbJzYpcVqkekP_PI8EuET8Stri6jXAp2xRv50LbuSbr-Ms2Dm6vjKxxPPVZnsyOqo3js2jt6lW8BdApQx6TxTxCIrFYfukJ3yg%3D%3D) Your gift of $100 or more to ACI today will help strengthen the bonds of our communities by lifting up the virtues of faith, liberty, community, and life.

Will you give today to support these cornerstone principles? They are essential to the success of our nation--principles that can be bolstered immeasurably and immediately by strengthening our families. To show my appreciation for your gift of $100 or more, you will receive an advanced signed copy of my new book "The Perilous Fight: Overcoming Our Culture's War on the American Family".

And to help pass down these important pillars to the next generation, I'lll also send you a free copy of my children's book "Why America Matters" that celebrates our great country and reminds us what a blessing it is to be an American.

You can make your secure gift here: [https://secure.americancornerstone.org/the-perilous-fight](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=4ff8c6f28cde4a27919181598d9bee7d&_e=9GamrgAanoviix8T2zXvCmNWd1sL7NnCGVAJW7-2CB9kricDt-rp0Zi-AfRgoNjUkxAxSjxFlZAtY9fbqa9kpNH8-JNmC4Hkbk97rA2NtF6VRXoJpwLgBzDBkd7VWaqxSbrFeve8wp8DuHOhKMlAlB8NEbL6w87sBB9eiRA_Q1X4uWtcUPnUQTdYfLzvvGxSaVTGc9wSDRFpoWhqNhhWr2jiansvCIPAFyJt5d-ZepK2kKHA64m0RXWNFPBQyR8eskhxPvEbG65iISSKUy88r7AY9mNQ0dkKSj1onWjJhrJQQwuZvWJvz1FQP1XsFVZOvLF2jEJ4kDWbG2QKsQRRbfrStIffaDkIsmZy87LGYZHK3CPp4UbFWbfJ3wmpKLqIHawQK4gJjilVPdvF41E74g%3D%3D)

Thank you for your interest in preserving and strengthening America's families!

Sincerely,

Dr. Ben Carson

body:
We’re only 11 days into June and I’ve already been up and down the state multiple times to attend some pretty great community events.
#
Friends,
We’re only 11 days into June and I’ve already been up and down the state _multiple times_ to attend some pretty great community events. So today I wanted to share a few photos so you can see what I’ve been up to as well.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240611-1?refcode=em20240611-1&amount=5&refcode2=608_21716_071uOv&akid=608%2E21716%2E071uOv)
First up was a visit to **Townsend**. Southern New Castle County was looking particularly beautiful in the Saturday morning sun as I joined Senators Stephanie Hansen and Kyra Hoffner for the annual **Town Parade and Strawberry Festival!**
[****](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240611-1?refcode=em20240611-1&amount=5&refcode2=608_21716_071uOv&akid=608%2E21716%2E071uOv)
Next up was **Delaware Pride in Dover**. I’ve gone to every Pride for years, and this had to be the biggest one yet. We have so much more work to do, but, together, we're proving that small states have big hearts.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240611-1?refcode=em20240611-1&amount=5&refcode2=608_21716_071uOv&akid=608%2E21716%2E071uOv)
The **Greek Festival** is always a treat as well! It was a pleasure meeting the volunteers and greeting neighbors out for a great meal with State Senator Spiros Mantzavinos and a Greek frappé in hand. 🇬🇷 🇬🇷 🇬🇷
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240611-1?refcode=em20240611-1&amount=5&refcode2=608_21716_071uOv&akid=608%2E21716%2E071uOv)
After that it was on to **Old New Castle** where we celebrated one of my personal favorite state holidays: **Separation Day!** It’s when Delaware declared its independence from Great Britain and Pennsylvania.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240611-1?refcode=em20240611-1&amount=5&refcode2=608_21716_071uOv&akid=608%2E21716%2E071uOv)
I was also thrilled to support Democratic State House candidates at a **grassroots fundraiser in Sussex**. We finally elected a Democrat in RD20 last year, and now it’s time to build on that momentum!
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240611-1?refcode=em20240611-1&amount=5&refcode2=608_21716_071uOv&akid=608%2E21716%2E071uOv)
As part of the organizing class at my first job, I know that when unions are strong, our economy is strong. That’s why I was so proud to join the **Delaware Building Trades** once again to celebrate the 2024 apprentice graduates! We’re indebted to all of their hard work building, securing, and enhancing our state.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240611-1?refcode=em20240611-1&amount=5&refcode2=608_21716_071uOv&akid=608%2E21716%2E071uOv)
And last but certainly not least, I was honored to attend the **Coalition of Black Unionists Gala**. It was a celebration of workers, solidarity, and the vital role that Black trade unionists have played in building our nation's unions and our economy.
It’s been a whirlwind start to this month, and we’re not slowing down any time soon. There’s so much work left to do to meet, hear from, and turn out voters all over Delaware — and I need your help to do it.
[**Will you pitch in $5 today to help me stay on the campaign trail listening to voters and fighting for ALL of our neighbors in Delaware?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240611-1?refcode=em20240611-1&amount=5&refcode2=608_21716_071uOv&akid=608%2E21716%2E071uOv)

Thank you,
Sarah McBride
