| California megamillionaire Eric Hovde was spotted in Laguna Beach, CA this weekend.
# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1&akid=2791%2E35263%2EPaRb-J)

DEI is thinly disguised racism.

Dear Friend of Liberty,

I wanted to bring to your attention a critical issue that affects us all.

Recently, Danielle Johnson bravely took a stand against DEI and discriminatory practices within her company, the Oregon Department of Environmental Quality.

However, when she merely questioned these racist DEI practices, she was called a racist in an all-company e-mail, had her pay cut, and was demoted.

DEI is thinly disguised racism. Danielle spoke up against it and now is fighting back by suing her employer.

This fight, however, isn't just about Danielle--it's about you, too. When her right to free speech is in danger, yours is also at risk. We cannot stand and watch as our fundamental rights are destroyed.

At Mountain States Legal Foundation, we are committed to supporting Danielle in her pursuit of justice. But we cannot do it without your help.

Getaways From basic to glampy, cabins offer a great home base for visitors looking to explore Yosemite National Park’s three magnificent sequoia groves. Trust us, it’s never too early to book one of these popular stays for a sequoia adventure. Success! As the fog rolled in over San Francisco, our extended redwoods community gathered for a wild “Take Me to the Trees” celebration. Check out fun gorpcore pictures and discover how much our supporters raised for the forests. Kickoff From June 12 to 16, more than 200 events will blossom at parks across the state, welcoming the public from near and far to discover a new hobby or explore a new destination. Member spotlight At a boarding school straight out of Harry Potter , a young boy connected with a giant redwood. Years later, with a major gift to the League, he has delivered on a personal vow and realized his dream of making a difference. Podcast The realization that water is the foundation for life in any landscape put Daniela Peña Corvillon on the path to shaping and restoring ecosystems—including the redwood forests—that depend on water. | | Instagram Post of the Month ---|--- | | ---|--- Check out this incredible footage of researchers from the Ancient Forest Society climbing the world’s largest tree, the General Sherman, for its first-ever health check. 👩⚕️🌳 Scientists scaled the 275-foot giant in Sequoia National Park to inspect it for bark beetle infestations, a rising threat to #GiantSequoias due to climate change. Thankfully, our ancient giant is putting up a strong fight against these tiny invaders! 💪🐞 🔬🌲 Read our blog (link in bio!) to learn more about the iconic General Sherman Tree and the groundbreaking methods being used to monitor these irreplaceable giants, including drone and satellite imagery. Peter, Our nation was built on the rule of law, but after 3+ years of Sleepy Joe Biden, it's all crashing down. It's my duty as a Congressman to make sure that doesn't happen. No one has been immune to the rampant crime epidemic threatening our streets. _**Just look at what's happening right here in Wisconsin...**_ In Fond du Lac, an illegal immigrant stabbed his wife with a steak knife and then ran from the police. Not too far away, another illegal immigrant human trafficked a 12-year-old girl, tying her up and blindfolding her. So much of this stems from one **GLARING** issue that the Democrats**REFUSE** to fix... _**Joe Biden's open borders.**_ I recently returned from a trip to the border. There, I witnessed with my own two eyes the chaos threatening our security and way of life.

If our democracy is going to endure, news organizations must learn from the mistakes of 2016.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86709324/478758237/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMTc2YjQwNTEtMmQyOC1lZjExLTg2ZDItNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=7grslC227nZPuxYKTGb1ZbqlsSz8I9VRV38b1ZAFNME=&emci=146b4051-2d28-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=176b4051-2d28-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=14016711)
Peter,
In 2016, Donald Trump skillfully manipulated cable news outlets like CNN and Fox News to spread dangerous lies and hatred. **He won because the media prioritized ratings and profits over truth, leaving our country forever changed.**
Today, history risks repeating itself. Desperate to win and avoid prison, Trump is doubling down on his lies and attempts to stoke fear and anger. Increasingly, he sounds less like a presidential candidate and more like an autocrat.
Unfortunately, judging by the coverage, the media hasn't learned anything in the last decade. They are giving Trump wall-to-wall coverage again and continue to play “both sides” instead of calling out Trump’s authoritarian ambition.
We founded COURIER as a direct response to these failures. We believe that restoring public trust in journalism is essential to strengthening our democracy. Building that trust starts with calling out misinformation and delivering quality, local news to the communities that need it most.

At COURIER, we will never compromise the truth just to play “both sides” or make a quick buck. Here are our promises to you:
**1\. We will always call out right-wing misinformation and tell the truth.** There are no “alternative facts” or “both sides.” There is the truth, and we will hold right-wing bad actors accountable for their lies.
**2. We will restore trust in journalism by covering local stories that matter most to the communities we serve.** The best antidote to bad information is good information. We will never compromise our values just to drive clicks and profit.
**3. We will deliver our news to the online spaces where people spend their time.** Social media news feeds. Inboxes. Search engines. By bringing quality journalism to the online spaces where misinformation is thriving, our reporting dismantles misinformation in real time before it can spread.
Right now, our newsrooms across ten battleground states (with more to come) are committed to reporting the facts on the issues that matter and calling out and combating misinformation wherever we see it.
We give all of our news for free, and don’t rely on a paywall or subscription model, so we can’t do this critical work without your support.

Through his relentless work ethic and untamable entrepreneurial spirit, he turned the first car dealership that he purchased in 2005 into one of the largest dealership groups in America. In 2016, Bernie recognized the value and transformational potential of blockchain technology, before it received mainstream attention, and moved much of his volunteer time and investment dollars into the space. In 2018 he co-founded ChampTitles, which grew to be quite successful as Bernie served as Chairman of the Board. After a long, successful career, Bernie sold most of his business to begin focusing on his calling: protecting the American dream for another generation. Solving our country’s problems requires common sense. In Washington, Bernie will fight to shrink government, protect our freedoms, stop the Chinese Communist party from taking our data and land, and always put America First. If we can’t make decisions over our own reproductive lives, we are not living in a democracy.

body:
The FBI just released new data indicating that there has been a 15 percent drop in violent crime overall in 2024
#

Team, it’s not every day that we get to see statistical proof that our movement for gun safety is making a difference, but today is one of those days.
The FBI just released new data indicating that rates of violent crime dropped 15 percent overall in the first few months of 2024 in comparison to the first few months of 2023. Murders have dropped by about 26 percent.
**This is a BIG deal, and it’s a testament to the work we’ve done together in our movement to end gun violence.**
Of course, this drop in violence crime could have never been possible without President Biden, the strongest gun safety president we’ve had in office in decades. He had the courage to stand up to the gun lobby and signed the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act into law in 2022. It is the most significant federal gun safety legislation passed in nearly 30 years.
President Biden has made it clear that as long as he’s in office, he will be a champion for gun safety. That’s why we’re doing everything we can to make sure he wins again this November.

**_CNN :_ UN chief says world is on ‘highway to climate hell’ as planet endures 12 straight months of unprecedented heat**
* * *
We are racing down a highway to _climate hell_ , and we need to slam on the brakes NOW. Every single month from June 2023 to May 2024 was the hottest on record, according to new data from _Copernicus_ , the EU’s climate monitoring service. This isn’t a fluke or a one-off — it’s an urgent warning we can’t ignore. And who is to blame? Greedy fossil fuel companies, of course. UN Secretary-General António Guterres didn't hold back when he called out the fossil fuel industry as the “godfathers of climate chaos.” That’s why we need to stop letting them pay to spread lies and twist the facts with huge advertising campaigns. For this week’s update, we’re excited to report back from the Texas Democratic Convention! Over the weekend, Lizzie and the team were in El Paso meeting with Democrats from #TX07 and across the state. On Friday evening, Lizzie took to the main convention stage to introduce the keynote speaker and the next Senator from Texas, Colin Allred.
You can watch her speech here, and see why she is—and we are—so fired up to elect Colin!
WATCH LIZZIE’S SPEECH [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_1pTGKa5E2Q]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_1pTGKa5E2Q [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_1pTGKa5E2Q]
We were so excited to see so many Democrats from home, especially the #TX07 delegates who traveled to El Paso and our neighbors from across Harris and Ft. Bend counties who are critical to the work ahead. It was great to meet with Democrats from across Texas, to thank them for their hard work, and to see all of the great energy for winning this year’s vital elections.

Election Day is only 21 weeks away. That’s not very many. Each of us has an important role to play—and with elections and runoffs for the November ballot now behind us, we are moving full speed ahead to November. As #TeamLizzie organizes to re-elect Lizzie and help other Democrats like Colin win their elections, we need everyone showing up in all the ways they can—whether that’s volunteering, contributing, spreading the word, voting, or all of the above. As we organize for the fall, we’ll have many opportunities to get involved and will be in touch to share them with you!
Thanks,
Team Lizzie

Friend, This weekend, my district celebrated Pride Month and honored our LGBTQ+ neighbors. This Pride month and all year round, we must keep fighting for LGBTQ+ people’s safety, dignity, rights, and liberation. Unfortunately, state lawmakers across the country are increasing attacks on LGBTQ+ people, including banning schools from talking about LGBTQ+ history or issues, banning students from using bathrooms aligned with their gender identity, and restricting or banning access to health care including gender-affirming care for trans people. **We must urgently affirm LGBTQ+ rights in federal law, to protect people in the mroe than 20 states that discriminate against them.** I’m a proud co-sponsor of the _Equality Act_ , which would protect LGBTQ+ people throughout the country from discrimination in employment, housing, credit, education, public spaces and services (including stores and restaurants), federally funded programs (including health care), and jury service. The executive director of the National Center for Transgender Equality spoke in support of the legislation, saying:
> _“Across the country, state legislators are taking aim at transgender people, trying to deny us appropriate health care, prohibiting us from participating in school sports or denying us access to public facilities._**_The Equality Act does more than just expand non-discrimination protections; it has the potential to dramatically change the lives of transgender people for the better_** _.”_
[**Please sign now to urge Congress to pass the**** _Equality Act_****and other policies to expand and affirm LGBTQ+ rights.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3_sEx477Renf-Md5EVu9dKi5xChOxQ1SizQOjf2XacRjETAjuF8t3sqGeZSZoyFVVPWmVl6FgRUEc4Wgg4fY-xwIP1cA0idc7FRjWNeWdEe4g-jGBbcGiDMY6LbCmfTD4mWNG_tFQYv5AWn8uaXefXaAps537tUQ-D8TC4ianXTc6i04Udu65tZSQ7nutxRomGMnaAzUD2oSS1DMwMbcJAz9G7iA3yO1S_goJLaaB5Z_pxYieRKs_5mgkTnMCkMh4_tOstoEwlVCrNgtlPtef75_dp0GIkaOL_YJe744tnZyOTancqU_kLbyc7yDBM6vZf5HIRe6RY8YwE0-73NLN3W3n9Shmpigi-XadF5i9bYnxENgb22N6i4pUGWkGqpKJf1XDlSVCCr6RyxBSZqjcc_AoirpU-95YKMlfsOr0REgfqLsrYILBoxhgJHsWWFCHQ/474/rw6DEBBhT56bL5VrI4M1xw/h1/h001.yMhuqAWgRm-RQiuG9c_RaxW_c3r9QYb4fYJYzgHNi28) | [SIGN NOW](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3_sEx477Renf-Md5EVu9dKi5xChOxQ1SizQOjf2XacRjETAjuF8t3sqGeZSZoyFVVPWmVl6FgRUEc4Wgg4fY-xwIP1cA0idc7FRjWNeWdEe4g-jGBbcGiDMY6LbCmfTD4kOdAdCi7wXN23IulTGLtVHtNEbYwI9XCg6WS7KMMkcaxO8nGjMWd5ds9wlZS7yR0HlD-AWWpVl1WYXUnBZUI2NiIoOdUnr0vbZvGrqi-xl2KcTDG19t4NvcJqP1rYTLZnuN2ZhGMkCShaO8va3a---c8KBsJlJRPjooB8pTz_BS2NyGyCctKWkA9Kmp-Yj8TgjDRwtjgn-TCYHGvGxZ7uQlNQC1Y5yNHTdEEHTnHRAYorEpKxcrKlUsvHebS_UQ-InW_gpjlAX9N3frqT1dt75D5MLZHjf-qf2Tl8oz4jUHVis0qHIL3Y-zXnrOS9X4Pw/474/rw6DEBBhT56bL5VrI4M1xw/h2/h001.UaVTw-Mp6tHLIewrFwPG9Z_0kGcBAglbA2Q3kdmrrFM)

When in office, the twice impeached and now convicted Donald Trump rolled back protections for trans people. Overturning these policies, **President Biden has released important new rules to expand protections for LGBTQ+ students, LGBTQ+ patients seeking health care, and more.**
At least 22 GOP-led states are already suing to try to block some of Biden’s progress, and Trump has said that he’d reverse these changes on “day one” if he’s re-elected.
If elected as president, Trump would not sign legislation like the _Equality Act_ into law. Instead, he’s promised to support policies like a federal ban on gender-affirming care for trans youth. Gender-affirming care is medically necessary and life-affirming, significantly reducing suicide risk, which is higher among trans people given anti-trans hate.
**We need to expand protections for LGBTQ+ people with actions at the federal level so they aren’t subject to the whims of a right-wing Supreme Court or a Republican presidential administration.**
More than 80% of Americans, including majorities across the political spectrum, support non-discrimination protections that include LGBTQ+ people. President Biden has supported and called for the passage of the _Equality Act_ for years, and we must urgently pass it in Congress to save lives.
[**Please sign to ask Congress to support the**** _Equality Act_****and other protections for LGBTQ+ Americans.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3_sEx477Renf-Md5EVu9dKi5xChOxQ1SizQOjf2XacRjETAjuF8t3sqGeZSZoyFVVPWmVl6FgRUEc4Wgg4fY-xwIP1cA0idc7FRjWNeWdEe4g-jGBbcGiDMY6LbCmfTD4mbALob6yW6szJ_yfUOD5lWoz1nTIXXv8GHKyp5oK_YxeKgtRDuUH5uZYXes-r74pw0TMngp9p6h7-WtVsQWJPn18FY-J6R0zRe0rv2GFgxZd1MT2msAtATFuTX9kMBwH3tZrgo6mhp_hMCsMb1o21GQ1O2gFLravEt-KQpt6YbDXpHhlF2fBvFyHYSyMN-gtsjkduqMTFseMQPEtljRFFDRYNCf6j4kzdNC5qBoGmToQndo2sl9HikJ1ash5-pI4bZViLsPkReV_FeqvrC9SzWxgjH0ig2TJ9LOpPl7lPLCpJwR2f77tcKx6huBxiiuTM/474/rw6DEBBhT56bL5VrI4M1xw/h3/h001.520u8-O3qUblUjMAmMr-4wIoajGGf3dlEqQ0l_qWCQ4)

clean_body: This weekend, my district celebrated Pride Month and honored LGBTQ+ neighbors. | | | Friend, This weekend, my district celebrated Pride Month and honored our LGBTQ+ neighbors. This Pride month and all year round, we must keep fighting for LGBTQ+ people’s safety, dignity, rights, and liberation. Unfortunately, state lawmakers across the country are increasing attacks on LGBTQ+ people, including banning schools from talking about LGBTQ+ history or issues, banning students from using bathrooms aligned with their gender identity, and restricting or banning access to health care including gender-affirming care for trans people. We must urgently affirm LGBTQ+ rights in federal law, to protect people in the mroe than 20 states that discriminate against them. I’m a proud co-sponsor of the Equality Act , which would protect LGBTQ+ people throughout the country from discrimination in employment, housing, credit, education, public spaces and services (including stores and restaurants), federally funded programs (including health care), and jury service. The executive director of the National Center for Transgender Equality spoke in support of the legislation, saying: “Across the country, state legislators are taking aim at transgender people, trying to deny us appropriate health care, prohibiting us from participating in school sports or denying us access to public facilities.The Equality Act does more than just expand non-discrimination protections; it has the potential to dramatically change the lives of transgender people for the better .” | When in office, the twice impeached and now convicted Donald Trump rolled back protections for trans people. Overturning these policies, President Biden has released important new rules to expand protections for LGBTQ+ students, LGBTQ+ patients seeking health care, and more. At least 22 GOP-led states are already suing to try to block some of Biden’s progress, and Trump has said that he’d reverse these changes on “day one” if he’s re-elected. If elected as president, Trump would not sign legislation like the Equality Act into law. Instead, he’s promised to support policies like a federal ban on gender-affirming care for trans youth. Gender-affirming care is medically necessary and life-affirming, significantly reducing suicide risk, which is higher among trans people given anti-trans hate. We need to expand protections for LGBTQ+ people with actions at the federal level so they aren’t subject to the whims of a right-wing Supreme Court or a Republican presidential administration. More than 80% of Americans, including majorities across the political spectrum, support non-discrimination protections that include LGBTQ+ people. President Biden has supported and called for the passage of the Equality Act for years, and we must urgently pass it in Congress to save lives. Thank you. Our fight for LGBTQ+ rights is connected to our fight for human dignity for marginalized people everywhere. This Pride Month and every month of the year, I will continue working for the collective liberation of all people. Always serving you, Rashida P.S. # FROM THE DESK OF ALAN DERSHOWITZ
---
| | Dear Reader, In over sixty years in the legal profession, I've experienced first hand the impact of both good journalism and bad journalism — mostly the latter — and just how important and rare it is to get things right.

**In today's media landscape there are far too many publications that get things wrong.** Many are more concerned with the political implications of a story than the basic facts.

**The New York Sun is different.** It's a paper that places principle over politics and people over party.

Its in-depth coverage of the legal challenges faced by President Trump serve as a case in point.

When I defended President Trump during his first impeachment, I faced an avalanche of criticism, but few papers made sufficient effort to fully appreciate the significance of the legal arguments.

The Sun's deeply knowledgeable leadership, including its editor Seth Lipsky and associate editor A.R. Hoffman are themselves students of the Constitution. It shows in their coverage, which I find to be first rate.

It will be no secret to you that I don't agree with everything that can be found in the Sun's pages, but I can say with confidence that its re-emergence is among the most important recent developments in American journalism.

I've been impressed by the Sun's growth so far, but I know it faces an uphill battle, one that I have pledged to join.

**The Sun's success will be a gift to the American people and to the cause of truth.** But to succeed, we need you to join us. I highly encourage you to join the Sun today.

Every person matters in this effort.

Don't wait. The battle to restore American journalism starts now.

## Note from The Host Committee
---
| Welcome back to Host Committee Happenings. The Democratic National Convention is only **69** days away!
The official application to volunteer at the 2024 Democratic National Convention is live! Thank you to the thousands of people who have already completed the application. If you are planning to volunteer but have not finished the application, be sure to visit [chicago2024.com/volunteer](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=3d63058fce&e=e789b9d47e).
---

## Opportunity for Chicago Area High School Students
---
| Our [“Welcome to Chicago” art competition](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=012f38473e&e=e789b9d47e) deadline has been **extended**! The competition will run until **June 17, 2024 at 5:00 PM CDT** and invites any currently enrolled full-time student at any public or private high school in the Chicago metropolitan area to submit original artwork inspired by the prompt “Welcome to Chicago.” Graduating seniors are also eligible to enter.
---
[](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=f85d433d50&e=e789b9d47e)
| All submitted artwork will be reviewed by a panel of judges. The winning design will be featured on commemorative memorabilia for the 2024 Democratic National Convention. The winner will also receive two credentials for one day of the convention and a $200 Visa gift card. Finalists will have their artwork featured digitally at official convention events and receive a $100 Visa gift card.
All entries must be original in concept, design, and execution and may not violate any U.S. copyright laws. Any entry that has been copied from an existing photo or image (including a painting, graphic, or advertisement) that was created by someone other than the student is a violation of the competition rules and will not be accepted. **Entries may not contain any political or partisan content, references to any political party or candidate, or hateful, religious, discriminatory, or sexually explicit language or imagery.**
For full submission guidelines and more details visit[ chicago2024.com/design](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=a7eb5b656b&e=e789b9d47e).
---

Thank you to all of our neighborhood ambassadors for their work to recruit volunteers from all 77 neighborhoods!

## DNC Brings Business Opportunities to Chicago Vendors
---
| | | | | | | | | | This summer's convention will be powered by hundreds of diverse, local vendors—each with their own story to tell! Our vendor directory and venue map are already connecting Chicago's small business community with the tens of thousands of visitors coming into town this August.
---
| [](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=71046aa468&e=e789b9d47e)

| _WATCH: WGN feature on DNC Vendors_

| If you're a vendor, don't miss out on this chance to put your business in the spotlight! Complete the Vendor Interest Form and our team will carefully review your submission and add your business to the[ Vendor Directory](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=00fe4bdee8&e=e789b9d47e) or[ Venue Map](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=28633d5068&e=e789b9d47e). Don't miss out - submit the form today!
For questions about vendors, please email [vendors@chicago2024.com](mailto:vendors@chicago2024.com), and for venue inquiries, please email [venues@chicago2024.com](mailto:venues@chicago2024.com).

## Chicago Convention Trivia
---
| **The 1884 Democratic National Convention took place in what venue that is now a major tourist attraction in Chicago?**
Email your answer to****[**press@chicago2024.com**](mailto:press@chicago2024.com?subject=Chicago%20Convention%20Trivia&body=null)**.** The winner will be featured in the next edition.

## 77 Spotlight
---
| Today’s neighborhood spotlight is on a trio of neighborhoods on the southwest side: **Ashburn** , **Chicago Lawn** , and **West Lawn**.
---
| While **Ashburn** served as the dumping site for the city’s ashes after the Great Chicago Fire, the neighborhood quickly experienced an industrial boom after World War II, and is now home to an abundance of attractions.
🍕 Taste some of Chicago’s finest thin-crust pizza at [Vito & Nick’s](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=38fd082224&e=e789b9d47e) which has been featured by Chef Guy Fieri and Businessman Dave Portnoy.
🥞 Enjoy a classic southern-style breakfast or brunch at [Starlight Restaurant.](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=894dfe0f97&e=e789b9d47e)
---
| 📷 _Vito and Nick’s_
---
| A primarily residential neighborhood, **Chicago Lawn** featured prominently in the Chicago Civil Rights Movement in the 1960’s, and today is filled with beautiful green space and home to a sprawling, diverse community.
🌲 Visit Marquette Park, one of Chicago’s largest public parks that features a nursery of nearly 90,000 trees and shrubs and a golf course.
🌮 Check out the string of Mexican restaurants along 63rd street that includes [Taqueria Michoacan](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=9fe4d4bb4f&e=e789b9d47e), [Mi Lindo Maravito](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=1674a2996e&e=e789b9d47e), and [La Esquina de Taco](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=bb8366d36c&e=e789b9d47e).
---
| Long known as a melting pot of the city’s many cultures, **West Lawn** is home to a host of local attractions.
🍕 Eat out at [Paisans](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=952f81e599&e=e789b9d47e), a local pizzeria which has been serving the West Lawn neighborhood for over 40 years. Paisans also features on the Host Committee’s [vendor directory](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=d91181a657&e=e789b9d47e).
🇱🇹 Explore the [Balzekas Museum of Lithuanian Culture](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=24691086d2&e=e789b9d47e), the only museum in the US devoted to the subjects of Lithuanian history, culture, and politics.
---
| 📷 _Balzekas Museum of Lithuanian Culture_
---
|
---
|
## Vendor Spotlights
---
| [Imee’s Mediterranean Kitchen](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=74c9195264&e=e789b9d47e), which recently relocated to Chicago’s vibrant **West Loop** neighborhood, specializes in authentic, fresh Mediterranean flavors. The recipes used at Imee's are rooted in three generations of Lebanese women: Nicole Nassif, the restaurant's founder, her mother, and two grandmothers. The four leaves on the lemon represent each of the women’s contributions. Imee’s healthy and authentic dishes are a perfect addition to gatherings of friends and family including bridal showers, birthday parties, and convention events. You can find Imee’s featured in the [DNC Venue Map](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=c059d1c115&e=e789b9d47e). Check out Imee’s Kitchen on [Instagram](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=05ff0baeda&e=e789b9d47e), on [Facebook](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=f8b738437e&e=e789b9d47e), and learn more about Imee’s story [here](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=9ee0e05827&e=e789b9d47e).
---
| _If you’d like to be featured in our newsletter or social media channels, please sign up for our vendor directory and email us with your business name, logo, description, and a picture or video that best describes your business._
---
|
---
|
## Staff Spotlight
---
| This week we are spotlighting **Belynda Wesley** , the Host Committee’s Deputy Director of Partnerships and Donor Relations.
---
| | | | | | | | | | Belynda is a recent addition to the Host Committee’s team and is excited to be a part of planning a historic and pivotal event. Originally from Miami, Florida, Belynda is particularly attracted to Chicago's rich cultural heritage. Belynda sees many parallels between Miami’s diverse culture and vibrant community to that of her new residence. One of Belynda’s many superpowers is cultivating, building, and maintaining partnerships, so she is looking forward to contributing to an event that brings people together and creates lasting memories. Outside of work, Belynda enjoys morning jogs, visiting iconic locations from movies, spending time with her friends, and traveling internationally.
---

The winner will also receive two credentials for one day of the convention and a $200 Visa gift card. Finalists will have their artwork featured digitally at official convention events and receive a $100 Visa gift card. All entries must be original in concept, design, and execution and may not violate any U.S. copyright laws. Any entry that has been copied from an existing photo or image (including a painting, graphic, or advertisement) that was created by someone other than the student is a violation of the competition rules and will not be accepted. Entries may not contain any political or partisan content, references to any political party or candidate, or hateful, religious, discriminatory, or sexually explicit language or imagery. The winner will be featured in the next edition. | | 77 Spotlight | Today’s neighborhood spotlight is on a trio of neighborhoods on the southwest side: Ashburn , Chicago Lawn , and West Lawn. | While Ashburn served as the dumping site for the city’s ashes after the Great Chicago Fire, the neighborhood quickly experienced an industrial boom after World War II, and is now home to an abundance of attractions. 🍕 Taste some of Chicago’s finest thin-crust pizza at which has been featured by Chef Guy Fieri and Businessman Dave Portnoy. 🥞 Enjoy a classic southern-style breakfast or brunch at | 📷 Vito and Nick’s | A primarily residential neighborhood, Chicago Lawn featured prominently in the Chicago Civil Rights Movement in the 1960’s, and today is filled with beautiful green space and home to a sprawling, diverse community. 🌲 Visit Marquette Park, one of Chicago’s largest public parks that features a nursery of nearly 90,000 trees and shrubs and a golf course. 🌮 Check out the string of Mexican restaurants along 63rd street that includes , , and . | Long known as a melting pot of the city’s many cultures, West Lawn is home to a host of local attractions. 🍕 Eat out at , a local pizzeria which has been serving the West Lawn neighborhood for over 40 years. I know Colin will be the leader Texans deserve in the Senate.
#
I'm all in to help Colin Allred defeat Ted Cruz.
I’m going to do everything I can to help him win, and a major part of that is helping him raise the resources to reach Texans in every corner of the state. So I’m humbly asking: [**Will you join me in our fight to finally send Ted Cruz packing by contributing a couple bucks between Colin’s campaign and Powered by People today?**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20240611.rCJImq&refcode=ema20240611-239634&t=1&akid=239634%2E444211%2Ecole3v)
**[DONATE $3](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20240611.rCJImq&refcode=ema20240611-239634&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=239634%2E444211%2Ecole3v)**
Colin is a Texan through and through, and he’s the leader we need in the Senate. He’s kind, empathetic, and one of the hardest working people I’ve ever known. He understands the challenges that families in Texas are facing, and he’s willing to work across the aisle to address them.
**We all know Ted Cruz is a clown.** I came within just 2.6% of defeating him in 2018, and in the years since, he’s only gotten worse – from plotting to overturn the 2020 election results to abandoning Texans to fly off to Cancun during a deadly winter storm.
I am confident Colin can win this neck-and-neck race and finally give Texans the sound, respectful leadership we deserve, **but winning is going to take a heck of a lot of resources.**
And while Cruz’s campaign is largely funded by a handful of GOP mega donors and special-interest groups, Colin is relying on grassroots supporters like you to chip in $3 here and $6 there to help him travel the state, compete in media markets across Texas, and ensure as many Democratic voters as possible make it to the polls.
**Colin’s team needs to raise $150,000 by midnight to keep this movement going strong, so please:**[**Will you join me in helping finish the job we started by chipping in $3 or more to Colin and Powered by People so that we can fire Ted Cruz this November?**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20240611.rCJImq&refcode=ema20240611-239634&t=3&akid=239634%2E444211%2Ecole3v)
**[DONATE $3](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20240611.rCJImq&refcode=ema20240611-239634&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=239634%2E444211%2Ecole3v)**
I know exactly what it’s like to run against Ted Cruz in Texas. It’s not going to be easy, but with enough people supporting Colin’s campaign, with all of us working together and doing our part, we can win this thing.
Let’s make Colin Allred our next U.S. Senator from Texas!
Beto O'Rourke

We thought you may be interested to receive this CONSERVATIVE NEWS ALERT from Illinois Review (https://www.illinoisreview.com/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=da36823ebd-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) .

By Illinois Review
The Illinois Republican Party is in DEFCON 1 as calls from influential party leaders from across the state grow for embattled chairman Don Tracy to remove state central committee member Mark Shaw as vice chairman of the state party after it was revealed that he broke party rules and purposefully misrepresented himself as a delegate during the state convention.
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/dele-gate-scandal-embarrasses-dominates-il-gop-as-leaders-pressure-don-tracy-to-remove-mark-shaw-as-vice-chair-of-the-state-party.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=da36823ebd-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

Since the discovery, party leaders have written letters demanding for Shaw to resign or be removed from his position. On Saturday, State Senator Jason Plummer – and a member of the SSC, posted on Facebook, writing, “I am very disappointed about the various troubling things that have been relayed to me and the party must take appropriate steps to definitively address any wrongdoing. The IL GOP is not a party for a select few, it should be representative of the millions of Illinoisans whose values we champion.”
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/dele-gate-scandal-embarrasses-dominates-il-gop-as-leaders-pressure-don-tracy-to-remove-mark-shaw-as-vice-chair-of-the-state-party.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=da36823ebd-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/dele-gate-scandal-embarrasses-dominates-il-gop-as-leaders-pressure-don-tracy-to-remove-mark-shaw-as-vice-chair-of-the-state-party.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=da36823ebd-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

Early on Monday, Lake County GOP Central Committee Chairman Keith Brin – who replaced Shaw as chairman, wrote a letter calling on all 102 county GOP leaders to do just that, writing, “We have crossed a rubicon.” Brin also called out Tracy and state party leadership, saying, “I gave the State Party every benefit of the doubt that under Chairman Tracy’s leadership that the Party would step up. Chairman Tracy scheduled a silly meeting to do...nothing.” Later on Monday, Cook County GOP Chairman Sean Morrison – a member of the SSC, wrote a letter calling on Shaw either to resign or be removed from his position as vice chairman of the Republican party and calling into question the reputation of the IL GOP and its leaders – calling the events a “significant issue” for the party.

Peter, a quick note here from me.

I like to take a couple minutes to myself when I can, and reflect about why we’re doing this work. Today I was thinking back to what it felt like in 2016 when Trump won.

That terrible, terrible feeling. We didn’t know exactly what would come next, but we knew it would be bad.

Trump’s Supreme Court — his appointed justices — struck down Roe v. Wade. His “leadership” in the pandemic led to more than a million deaths. And his conspiracies and election denial pushed our democracy to the brink on January 6th.

Do not, ever, let anyone tell you that elections do not matter.

I wake up every day ready to do whatever I can to defeat Kari Lake, Trump’s “MAGA Queen.” She’s dangerous enough on her own, but if she and Trump both win in Arizona this year, we’re all in big trouble.

The work we do between now and November is going to make all the difference on election day, and we have to make the most of each day.

Today, I’m asking you to make a donation to my campaign. Consider it an act of hope — hope that we can continue the progress we’ve made over the last few years, and that we can stop folks like Trump and Lake from gaining any more power and influence.

Can I count on you?

# FROM THE DESK OF ALAN DERSHOWITZ
---
| | Dear Reader, In over sixty years in the legal profession, I've experienced first hand the impact of both good journalism and bad journalism — mostly the latter — and just how important and rare it is to get things right.

**In today's media landscape there are far too many publications that get things wrong.** Many are more concerned with the political implications of a story than the basic facts.

**The New York Sun is different.** It's a paper that places principle over politics and people over party.

Its in-depth coverage of the legal challenges faced by President Trump serve as a case in point.

When I defended President Trump during his first impeachment, I faced an avalanche of criticism, but few papers made sufficient effort to fully appreciate the significance of the legal arguments.

The Sun's deeply knowledgeable leadership, including its editor Seth Lipsky and associate editor A.R. Hoffman are themselves students of the Constitution. It shows in their coverage, which I find to be first rate.

It will be no secret to you that I don't agree with everything that can be found in the Sun's pages, but I can say with confidence that its re-emergence is among the most important recent developments in American journalism.

I've been impressed by the Sun's growth so far, but I know it faces an uphill battle, one that I have pledged to join.

**The Sun's success will be a gift to the American people and to the cause of truth.** But to succeed, we need you to join us. I highly encourage you to join the Sun today.

Every person matters in this effort.

Don't wait. The battle to restore American journalism starts now.

I spent my life studying the Constitution and earned a law degree so that I could **protect** the basic freedoms we are all promised in this amazing country.

**But I knew my mission wasn’t finished there.**

I realized that I had to take our fight nationwide, so I decided to run for Senate.

**I shocked the nation by defeating an incumbent Democrat who HATED President Trump and our conservative values.**

Peter, my values are rooted in our Constitution and God. Those 2 things guide me as your Senator, and I’m proud to say it.

But right now, we are watching as woke liberals take away our freedoms and attack our livelihood. These times are trying, Peter, but we must fight for what we believe in.

body:
Hi Derek.
It’s Alexander Vindman, reaching out to you with a personal request.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2907?c0=june2024_abs_em_vindman.biPLDf&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20240611_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1003&akid=6680%2E5257348%2EJI4U_x ]Can you split a contribution between Adam Schiff’s Senate campaign and
my twin brother Eugene’s campaign for Congress today? I ask because I know
I can count on you.

You probably know this already, but Eugene and I value integrity and
honesty above all else.

These principles guided us throughout our decades of military service.
It's what compelled us to blow the whistle on Donald Trump's attempt to
extort our allies in Ukraine when we overheard a concerning phone call.
And now, it's what motivated Eugene to run for Congress.

The same goes for Adam Schiff — leader of the first House impeachment
inquiry and lead manager for Trump’s first impeachment trial. Adam is a
fearless leader and is running for Senate to continue his fight to defend
our constitution and protect our democracy.

But more than that, they both will fight to restore and expand the
fundamental rights right-wing forces have worked so hard to take away: the
right to reproductive freedom, the right to vote, the right for us and our
kids to live without fear of gun violence.

But Adam and Eugene can't win these fights alone. I am with them – nothing
is more important to me right now. But we need you with us, standing by
our side, because Trump and his allies will do whatever they can to keep
Eugene out of Washington and Adam out of the Senate.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2907?c0=june2024_abs_em_vindman.biPLDf&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20240611_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=6680%2E5257348%2EJI4U_x ]So, Derek,
can I count on you to split a contribution between Adam Schiff’s Senate

Virginia?

Hi Peter, Congressman Maxwell Frost here. I’m reaching out today to tell you about my colleague Becca Balint, who quickly became one of my closest friends in Washington last year when we were newly sworn-in members together. [](http://clicksp.frostforcongress.com/f/a/l00uDH4py6JET6vTBvL9vQ~~/AAPPAAA~) Becca ran for Congress in 2022 on a platform of courage and kindness. As one of only three out lesbians in the House of Representatives, uplifting LGBTQ+ Americans isn’t just an item on Becca’s Pride Month to-do list — it’s a full-time job, a value deeply rooted in her own identity.

**And every day, Becca takes on legislators in Congress who are hellbent on reversing gay marriage, banning gender-affirming health care, and attacking trans youth.**

Becca’s fearless dedication to doing the right thing has already made her a target of right-wing vitriol and hate online. And with the November elections right around the corner, we need to come together as progressives and stand behind Becca. [Peter, will you join me in celebrating Pride Month by splitting a donation between my and Becca’s re-election campaigns?](http://clicksp.frostforcongress.com/f/a/l00uDH4py6JET6vTBvL9vQ~~/AAPPAAA~) | | | [Donate $10](http://clicksp.frostforcongress.com/f/a/EFh4BMv5vryFd1UYWGdcpQ~~/AAPPAAA~)

# FROM THE DESK OF ALAN DERSHOWITZ
---
| | Dear Reader, In over sixty years in the legal profession, I've experienced first hand the impact of both good journalism and bad journalism — mostly the latter — and just how important and rare it is to get things right.

**In today's media landscape there are far too many publications that get things wrong.** Many are more concerned with the political implications of a story than the basic facts.

**The New York Sun is different.** It's a paper that places principle over politics and people over party.

Its in-depth coverage of the legal challenges faced by President Trump serve as a case in point.

When I defended President Trump during his first impeachment, I faced an avalanche of criticism, but few papers made sufficient effort to fully appreciate the significance of the legal arguments.

The Sun's deeply knowledgeable leadership, including its editor Seth Lipsky and associate editor A.R. Hoffman are themselves students of the Constitution. It shows in their coverage, which I find to be first rate.

It will be no secret to you that I don't agree with everything that can be found in the Sun's pages, but I can say with confidence that its re-emergence is among the most important recent developments in American journalism.

I've been impressed by the Sun's growth so far, but I know it faces an uphill battle, one that I have pledged to join.

**The Sun's success will be a gift to the American people and to the cause of truth.** But to succeed, we need you to join us. I highly encourage you to join the Sun today.

Every person matters in this effort.

Don't wait. The battle to restore American journalism starts now.

name: Jill Stein
subject: Biden’s deportation scheme putschildren’s lives at risk
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
Asylum is a human right. Period.

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=biden_border_policy&n=1)
---
_“No one puts their children in a boat, unless the water is safer than the land.”_ Warsan Shire, Home Peter

Last week Joe Biden issued a new executive order on immigration that is immoral on its face and an affront to basic human rights.

_It’s also a grave political miscalculation.

_ Team Biden has wagered that by adopting Donald Trump’s immigration policies, he can deflect criticism from Republicans on his handling of the border crisis – and potentially earn some of their votes.

Nothing could be further from the truth.

An Oxford University study published earlier this year revealed that, time and again, when liberal and left institutions adopt right-wing policies to try and appeal to the mythical “swing voter,” they lose. Worse, they lose to the most reactionary elements in right-wing politics.

Biden’s new executive order makes it MORE likely that conservative voters will back Trump in November. It’s akin to walking us off a cliff into American fascism. We will all pay the price for Biden’s gamble on our democracy, but the people who will be directly and immediately impacted are the thousands of families with young children seeking asylum, safety, freedom, and opportunity in our country.
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=biden_border_policy&n=2)
---
The New York Times reported that 40% of all migrants crossing the border today are parents and their children.

These are people who have tried to assert their legal right to asylum by following the process, seeking an appointment for a hearing of their claim. But as Democrats and Republicans in Congress have colluded to deprive the immigration courts of the funding they need to process those claims, they’re often waiting 10 months or more just to get an appointment.

The lucky ones get a space in one of the handful of migrant centers operated by nonprofits on the Mexican side of the border. **The rest are left to live on the street where they are targeted by cartels for extortion, exploitation, or worse.** No shock, then, that many choose to risk crossing the border on foot.

Biden’s solution to this self-made crisis is not to direct more resources to process asylum claims faster, but to send these families right back into the mouth of the shark – deporting them within days instead of hearing their asylum claims.

**These families are fleeing political persecution, cartel violence, and economic devastation that is largely the product of American policy.

****When I am elected, we will address both the immediate material needs of asylum seekers and the root causes driving migration.**
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=biden_border_policy&n=3 "DONATE NOW") [DONATE NOW](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=biden_border_policy&n=3)
---
We will completely overhaul the broken and abusive immigration system and honor our obligation to asylum seekers, welcoming immigrants of all types into our country to enrich our communities and the tapestry of American life.

We will create a timely, ethical, transparent, and dignified path to citizenship for immigrants, asylum seekers, and refugees.

You can read my full immigration policy at [**jillstein2024.com/platform**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/r?u=Qj32F8ZTIcBOzthgR25-gF2J_V8cRlHgwGIBI_1lcLQ0Ce7w_K4rbPSVLguxOifF&e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=biden_border_policy&n=4).

And you can help make this a reality by supporting our campaign for people, planet, and peace. Your contributions will help ensure that every American can vote for the only pro-worker, pro-peace, and pro-planet campaign that will be on the ballot across the country this November.
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=biden_border_policy&n=5 "DONATE NOW") [DONATE NOW](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=biden_border_policy&n=5)
---
Seeking asylum is a basic human right. It’s also a legal right under U.S. federal law. It is our duty to offer safe harbor to people escaping violence that we brought to their shores.

When I am president, we will.

In solidarity and gratitude,

Jill

The American people are learning what Trump said about our wounded and fallen warriors, and they do not like what they are hearing.
#
At a rally in Nevada, Trump finally responded to the reports that he insulted the fallen when he canceled an appearance at an American war cemetery in France.
He said you’d have to be a psycho to call Americans who fell in battle “suckers” and “losers,” and we agree.
But that comment is quite odd, given that he called Americans who fell in battle “suckers” and “losers.” His own former Chief of Staff confirmed it. Personally.
Remember:
* Trump attacked John McCain and every Prisoner of War — “I like people who weren’t captured” — and called him a loser after he had passed away.
* He said, “It doesn’t look good for me,” and refused to be seen with wounded warriors.
* He’s gone after Gold Star family members, who lost their loved ones in war, for opposing him.
* He callously told one grieving wife that her husband “knew what he was getting into.”

There is a clear, repeated pattern of Trump going after Troops, Veterans and their families.
But of all the despicable things Trump has done, his insults and degradations against the wounded and fallen men and women who fought for our country are among the worst.
But what’s clear is this — he knows this hurts him. He might weasel out of jail time for his felonies, or delay his court cases thanks to judges he appointed. But the American people are learning what Trump said about our wounded and fallen warriors, and they do not like what they are hearing.
We have to make sure they keep hearing it, and that’s exactly what VoteVets is going to do.
